original: adveṣarāgibhiḥ | idaṃ bāhyadharmānuṣṭhāne dvitīyaṃ kāraṇam | vyāmohaḥ pūrvam uktaḥ | anena lobhādaya ucyante, rāgadveṣagrahaṇasya pradarśanārthatvāt | lobhena mantratantrādiṣu pravartayanti | atha vā rāgadveṣayor lobho 'ntarbhūtaḥ | ātmani[2] ye bhogopāyās teṣu raktāḥ[3] upāyāntareṇa[4] jīvituṃ asamarthā[5] liṅgadhāraṇādinā jīvanti | tad uktam: "bhasmakapālādidhāraṇam, nagnatā, kāṣāye ca vāsasī buddhipauruṣahīnānāṃ jīvikā" iti | dveṣo viparītānuṣṭhānakāraṇam | dveṣapradhānā hi nātīva tattvāvadhāraṇe samarthā bhavanti, ato 'dharmam eva dharmatvenādhyavasyantīti | atha vobhāv api rāgadveṣau tattvāvadhāraṇe pratibandhakau | satyām api kasyāṃcic chāstravedanamātrāyāṃ labdhe 'pi vidvadvyapadeśe rāgadveṣavattayā viparītānuṣṭhānaṃ saṃbhavati | jānānā api yathāvac chāstraṃ kasyacid dveṣyasyopaghātāya priyasya copakarāya kauṭasākṣyādyadharmaṃ sevante[6] | teṣāṃ vedamūlam evānuṣṭhānam ity aśakyaniścayam, kāraṇāntarasya rāgadveṣalakṣaṇasya saṃbhavāt | atas tatpratiṣedhaḥ |
analyzed: a dveṣa rāgibhiḥ idam bāhya dharma anuṣṭhāne dvitīyam kāraṇam vyāmohaḥ pūrvam uktaḥ anena lobha ādayaḥ ucyante rāga dveṣa grahaṇasya pradarśana artha tvāt lobhena mantra tantra ādiṣu pravartayanti atha vā rāga dveṣayoḥ lobhaḥ ntarbhūtaḥ ātmani ye bhoga upāyāḥ teṣu raktāḥ upāya antareṇa jīvitum asamarthāḥ liṅga dhāraṇā ādinā jīvanti tat uktam bhasma kapāla ādi dhāraṇam nagna tā kāṣāye ca vāsasī buddhi pauruṣa hīnānām jīv

original: paras tu kāmātmatām icchāmātrasaṃbandhamātraṃ padārthaṃ manvānaś codayati: na caivehāsty akāmateti | na ceha loke kācid akāminaḥ pravṛttir astīty arthaḥ | āstāṃ tāvat kṛṣivāṇijyādi vyutpannabuddhinā kriyamāṇam, yaḥ svayaṃ vedādhigamaḥ vedādhyayanaṃ bālaḥ kāryate pitrādinā tāḍyamānaḥ so 'pi na kāmam antareṇopapadyate | adhyayanaṃ hi śabdoccāraṇarūpam | na coccāraṇam icchayā vinā nirghātadhvanivad uttiṣṭhati | icchati cet kim iti tāḍyata iti | saiva tathecchopajanyate | abhimate tu viṣaye svayam upajāyata ity etāvān viśeṣaḥ | yaś cāyaṃ vaidiko vedavihitaḥ karmayogo darśapūrṇamāsādi karmānuṣṭhāne nityatvenāvagataḥ so 'pi na prāpnoti | na hy anicchato devatoddeśena svadravyatyāgopapattiḥ | tasmāt kāmātmatāniṣedhe sarvaśrautasmārtakarmaniṣedhaḥ prasakta iti || 2.2 ||
analyzed: paraḥ tu kāma ātmatām icchā mātra saṃbandha mātram padārtham manvānaḥ codayati na ca eva iha asti akāma tā iti na ca iha loke kācid akāminaḥ pravṛttiḥ asti iti arthaḥ āstām tāvat kṛṣi vāṇijya ādi vyutpanna buddhinā kriyamāṇam yaḥ svayam veda adhigamaḥ veda adhyayanam bālaḥ kāryate pitṛ ādinā tāḍyamānaḥ saḥ u pi na kāmam antareṇa upapadyate adhyayanam hi śabda uccāraṇa rūpam na ca uccāraṇam icchayā vinā nirghāta dhvani vat uttiṣṭh

original: saṃkalpamūlaḥ kāmo vai yajñāḥ saṃkalpasaṃbhavāḥ|
analyzed: saṃkalpa mūlaḥ kāmaḥ vai yajñāḥ saṃkalpa saṃbhavāḥ

original: vratāni yamadharmāś ca sarve saṃkalpajāḥ smṛtāḥ || 2.3 ||
analyzed: vratāni yama dharmāḥ ca sarve saṃkalpa jāḥ smṛtāḥ

original: tataś ca yad uktaṃ yāgasya kāmena vinā na svarūpaniṣpattir iti, tad anena vispaṣṭaṃ kṛtvā kathayati | saṃkalpo yāgādīnāṃ mūlaṃ kāmasya ca | yāgādīṃś cikīrṣann avaśayaṃ saṃkalpaṃ karoti | saṃkalpe ca kriyamāṇe tatkāraṇena kāmena saṃnidhātavyam aniṣṭenāpi | yathā pākārthino jvalanaṃ kurvatas tatsamānakāraṇo dhūmo 'py aniṣṭo jāyate | tatra na śakyaṃ yajñādayaḥ kariṣyante, kāmaś ca na bhaviṣyatīti |
analyzed: tatas ca yat uktam yāgasya kāmena vinā na svarūpa niṣpattiḥ iti tat anena vispaṣṭam kṛtvā kathayati saṃkalpaḥ yāga ādīnām mūlam kāmasya ca yāga ādīn cikīrṣan avaśayam saṃkalpam karoti saṃkalpe ca kriyamāṇe tad kāraṇena kāmena saṃnidhātavyam aniṣṭena api yathā pāka arthinaḥ jvalanam kurvataḥ tad samāna kāraṇaḥ dhūmaḥ api aniṣṭaḥ jāyate tatra na śakyam yajña ādayaḥ kariṣyante kāmaḥ ca na bhaviṣyati iti

original: atha ko 'yaṃ saṃkalpo nāma yaḥ sarvakriyāmūlam |
analyzed: atha kaḥ yam saṃkalpaḥ nāma yaḥ sarva kriyā mūlam

original: ucyate | yac cetaḥsaṃdarśanaṃ nāma, yadanantaraṃ prārthanādhyavasāyau krameṇa bhavataḥ | ete hi mānasā vyāpārāḥ sarvakriyāpravṛttiṣu mūlatāṃ pratipadyante | na hi bhautikā vyāpārās tam antareṇa saṃbhavanti | tathā hi, prathamaṃ padārthasvarūpanirūpaṇam: "ayaṃ padārtha imām arthakriyāṃ sādhayati" iti yaj jñānaṃ sa iha saṃkalpo 'bhipretaḥ | anantaraṃ prārthanā bhavati icchā | saiva kāmaḥ | "katham aham idam anena sādhayāmi" iti icchāyāṃ satyām adhyavasyati "karomi" iti niścinoti[13] so 'dhyavasāyaḥ | tataḥ sādhanopādāne bāhyavyāpāraviṣaye pravartate | tathā hi, bubhukṣita ādau bhujikriyāṃ paśyati, tata icchati "bhuñjīya" iti, tato 'dhyavasyati "vyāpārāntarebhyo vinivṛttya bhojanaṃ karomi" iti, tataḥ karmakāraṇasthānādhikāriṇa āha "sajjīkuruta rasavatīm, saṃcārayata" iti |
analyzed: ucyate yat cetaḥsaṃdarśanam nāma yat anantaram prārthanā adhyavasāyau krameṇa bhavataḥ ete hi mānasāḥ vyāpārāḥ sarva kriyā pravṛttiṣu mūla tām pratipadyante na hi bhautikāḥ vyāpārāḥ tam antareṇa saṃbhavanti tathā hi prathamam padārtha svarūpa nirūpaṇam ayam padārthaḥ imām arthakriyām sādhayati iti yat jñānam saḥ iha saṃkalpaḥ bhipretaḥ anantaram prārthanā bhavati icchā sā eva kāmaḥ katham aham idam anena sādhayāmi iti icchāyām satyām

original: nanv evaṃ sati na yajñādayaḥ saṃkalpamātrād bhavanti, api tu saṃkalpaprārthanādhyavasāyebhyaḥ | tatra kim ucyate "yajñāḥ saṃkalpasaṃbhavāḥ" iti |
analyzed: nanu evam sati na yajña ādayaḥ saṃkalpa mātrāt bhavanti api tu saṃkalpa prārthanā adhyavasāyebhyaḥ tatra kim ucyate yajñāḥ saṃkalpa saṃbhavāḥ iti

original: saṃkalpasyādyakāraṇatvād adoṣaḥ | ata evottaratra "nākāmasya kriyā kācid dṛśyate" iti vakṣyati |
analyzed: saṃkalpasya ādi akāraṇa tvāt adoṣaḥ atas eva uttaratra na akāmasya kriyā kācid dṛśyate iti vakṣyati

original: vratāni | mānaso 'dhyavasāyo vratam: "idaṃ mayā yāvajjīvaṃ kartavyam" iti yad vihitam | yathā snātakavratāni | yamadharmāḥ pratiṣedharūpāḥ ahiṃsādayaḥ | kartavyeṣu pravṛttiḥ, niṣiddhebhyo nivṛttiḥ, nāntareṇa saṃkalpam asti || 2.3 ||
analyzed: vratāni mānasaḥ dhī avasāyaḥ vratam idam mayā yāvajjīvam kartavyam iti yat vihitam yathā snātaka vratāni yama dharmāḥ pratiṣedha rūpāḥ ahiṃsā ādayaḥ kartavyeṣu pravṛttiḥ niṣiddhebhyaḥ nivṛttiḥ na antareṇa saṃkalpam asti

original: akāmasya kriyā kācid dṛśyate neha karhicit |
analyzed: akāmasya kriyā kācid dṛśyate na iha karhicit

original: yad yad dhi kurute kiṃcit tat tat kāmasya ceṣṭitam || 2.4 ||
analyzed: yat yat hi kurute kiṃcid tat tat kāmasya ceṣṭitam

original: pūrveṇa śāstrīye pravṛttinivṛttī saṃkalpādhīne vyākhyāte | anena laukikeṣu karmasu tadadhīnatocyata iti viśeṣaḥ | neha loke karhicit kadācid api jāgradavasthāyāṃ kriyā[14] kācid[15] anuṣṭheyatvenānicchataḥ saṃbhavati | yat kiṃcil laukikaṃ vaidikaṃ vā kurute karma vihitaṃ pratiṣiddhaṃ ca tat sarvaṃ kāmasya ceṣṭitam | || 2.4 ||
analyzed: pūrveṇa śāstrīye pravṛtti nivṛttī saṃkalpa adhīne vyākhyāte anena laukikeṣu karmasu tad adhīna tā ucyate iti viśeṣaḥ na iha loke karhicit kadācid api jāgrat avasthāyām kriyā kācid anuṣṭheya tvena an icchataḥ saṃbhavati yat kiṃcid laukikam vaidikam vā kurute karma vihitam pratiṣiddham ca tat sarvam kāmasya ceṣṭitam

original: hetutvāc ceṣṭitaṃ kāmasyaivety uktam | tad idam atisaṃkaṭam, kāmātmatā na praśastā, na cānayā vinā kiṃcid anuṣṭhānam asti | atra pratividhatte |
analyzed: hetu tvāt ceṣṭitam kāmasya eva iti uktam tat idam ati saṃkaṭam kāma ātma tā na praśastā na ca anayā vinā kiṃcid anuṣṭhānam asti atra pratividhatte

original: teṣu samyag vartamāno gacchaty amaralokatām |
analyzed: teṣu samyak vartamānaḥ gacchati amara loka tām

original: yathāsaṃkalpitāṃś ceha sarvān kāmān samaśnute || 2.5 ||
analyzed: yathā saṃkalpitān ca iha sarvān kāmān samaśnute

original: teṣu kāmeṣu samyag vartitavyam | kā punaḥ samyagvṛttiḥ | yad yathāśrutaṃ tat tathaivānuṣṭheyam | nityeṣu phalaṃ nābhisaṃdheyam, aśrutatvāt | kāmyeṣu tv aniṣedhaḥ, teṣāṃ tathāśrutatvāt | phalasādhanatayaiva tāni vidhito 'vagamyante | phalānicchos tadanuṣṭhānam aśrutakaraṇaṃ[16] syāt | nityeṣu phalābhisaṃdhir vyāmoha eva | na hy abhisaṃdhimātrāt pramāṇato 'navagate phalasādhanatve phalam utpadyate | evaṃ kurvan gacchati prāpnoty amaralokatām | amarāḥ devāḥ, teṣāṃ lokaḥ svargaḥ | tannivāsāt amareṣu lokaśabdaḥ sthānasthāninor abhedāt "mañcāḥ krośanti" itivat | tenāyaṃ samāsaḥ: amarāś ca te lokāś ca amaralokāḥ, tadbhāvaḥ amaralokatā | devajanatvaṃ prāpnoti devatvaṃ prāpnotīty arthaḥ | vṛttānurodhād evam uktam | atha vā, amarāṃl lokayati paśyaty amaralokaḥ | "karmany aṇ[17]" (Pāṇ 3.2.1) | tadantād bhavapratyayaḥ | devadarśī saṃpadyate | anenāpi prakāreṇa svargaprāptir evoktā bhavati | atha vā, amara iva lokyate loke |
analyzed: teṣu kāmeṣu samyak vartitavyam kā punar samyak vṛttiḥ yat yathāśrutam tat tathā eva anuṣṭheyam nityeṣu phalam na abhisaṃdheyam aśruta tvāt kāmyeṣu tu aniṣedhaḥ teṣām tathā aśruta tvāt phala sādhanatayā eva tāni vidhitaḥ vagamyante phala an icchoḥ tat anuṣṭhānam aśruta karaṇam syāt nityeṣu phala abhisaṃdhiḥ vyāmohaḥ eva na hi abhisaṃdhi mātrāt pramāṇataḥ na vagate phala sādhana tve phalam utpadyate evam kurvan gacchati prāpnoti amara lok

original: arthavādaś cāyam | nātra svargaḥ phalatvena vidhīyate, nityānāṃ phalābhāvāt, kāmyānāṃ ca nānāphalaśravaṇāt | tena svargaprāptyā śāstrānuṣṭhānasaṃpattir evocyate lakṣaṇayā | yad arthaṃ karmaṇām[18] anuṣṭhānaṃ tat saṃpadyata ity arthaḥ | tatra nityānāṃ pratyavāyānutpattir vidhyarthasaṃpattir vā prayojanam | kāmyeṣu tu yathāsaṃkalpitān yathāśrutaṃ saṃkalpitān | prayogakāle yasya karmaṇo yat phalaṃ śrutaṃ tat saṃkalpya abhisaṃdhāya manasā kāmayitvā "idam aham ataḥ phalaṃ prāpnuyām" iti, tataḥ sarvān kāmān kāmyān arthān samaśnute prāpnoti |
analyzed: arthavādaḥ ca ayam na atra svargaḥ phala tvena vidhīyate nityānām phala abhāvāt kāmyānām ca nānā phala śravaṇāt tena svarga prāptyā śāstra anuṣṭhāna saṃpattiḥ eva ucyate lakṣaṇayā yat artham karmaṇām anuṣṭhānam tat saṃpadyate iti arthaḥ tatra nityānām pratyavāya anutpattiḥ vidhi artha saṃpattiḥ vā prayojanam kāmyeṣu tu yathā saṃkalpitān yathāśrutam saṃkalpitān prayoga kāle yasya karmaṇaḥ yat phalam śrutam tat saṃkalpya abhisaṃd

original: ataḥ parihṛtā saṃkaṭāpattiḥ, yato na sarvaviṣayaḥ kāmo niṣidhyate | kiṃ tarhi, nityeṣu phalābhilāṣalakṣaṇaḥ | sādhanasaṃpattis tu kāmyaiva |
analyzed: atas parihṛtā saṃkaṭa āpattiḥ yatas na sarva viṣayaḥ kāmaḥ niṣidhyate kim tarhi nityeṣu phala abhilāṣa lakṣaṇaḥ sādhana saṃpattiḥ tu kāmyā eva

original: brahmavādinas tu sauryādīnāṃ niṣedharthaṃ kāmātmateti manyante | phalārthitayā kriyamāṇā bandhātmakā bhavanti, niṣkāmas tu brahmārpaṇanyāyena kurvan mucyate | tad uktaṃ bhagavatā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanena "mā karmaphalahetur bhūḥ" (BhG 2.47) | tathā:
analyzed: brahma vādinaḥ tu saurya ādīnām niṣedha artham kāma ātma tā iti manyante phala arthi tayā kriyamāṇāḥ bandha ātmakāḥ bhavanti niṣkāmaḥ tu brahma arpaṇa nyāyena kurvan mucyate tat uktam bhagavatā kṛṣṇadvaipāyanena mā karma phala hetuḥ bhūḥ tathā

analyzed: sādhanānām akṛtsna tvāt maurkhyāt karma kṛtaḥ tathā

analyzed: phalasya ca abhisaṃdhānāt apavitraḥ vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ iti

analyzed: bahavaḥ ca atra vyākhyā vikalpāḥ asāra tvāt tu na pradarśitāḥ

analyzed: khilaḥ dharma mūlam smṛti śīle ca tad vidām

analyzed: ācāraḥ ca eva sādhūnām ātmanaḥ tuṣṭiḥ eva ca

original: ko 'syābhisaṃbandhaḥ | yāvatā dharmo 'tra vaktavyatayā pratijñātaḥ | sa ca vidhipratiṣedhalakṣaṇaḥ | tatra na vedasya dharmamūlatā vidheyā: "vedo dharmamūlatvena jñātavyo dharmaprāmāṇya āśrayaṇīyaḥ" iti,[19] antareṇaivopadeśaṃ tatsiddheḥ | na hi manvādyupadeśasamadhigamyaṃ vedasya dharmamūlatvam, api tu abādhitaviṣayapratītijanakatvena apauruṣeyatayā ca puruṣasaṃsargadoṣair api mithyābhidhānāśaṅkābhāvāt, svataś ca śabdasyāduṣṭatvāt, pratyakṣavat svataḥprāmāṇyasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: kaḥ sya abhisaṃbandhaḥ yāvatā dharmaḥ u tra vaktavya tayā pratijñātaḥ sa ca vidhi pratiṣedha lakṣaṇaḥ tatra na vedasya dharma mūla tā vidheyā vedaḥ dharma mūla tvena jñātavyaḥ dharma prāmāṇye āśrayaṇīyaḥ iti antareṇa eva upadeśam tad siddheḥ na hi manu ādi upadeśa samadhigamyam vedasya dharma mūla tvam api tu abādhita viṣaya pratīti janaka tvena apauruṣeya tayā ca puruṣa saṃsarga doṣaiḥ api mithyā abhidhāna āśaṅkā bhāvāt svatas ca

original: athocyate: nyāyataḥ siddhaṃ vedasya prāmāṇyam anūdya manvādismṛtīnāṃ tanmūlatā vacanena jñāpyata iti |
analyzed: athā ucyate nyāyataḥ siddham vedasya prāmāṇyam anūdya manu ādi smṛtīnām tad mūla tā vacanena jñāpyate iti

original: tad api na | tatrāpi pūrvajñānasāpekṣatvāt, smaraṇasya bhrāntivipralambhādīnāṃ mahājanaparigrahādinā nirastatvāt, atīndriyārthadarśanasyāśakyabhāvāc ca puruṣasya ca svānubhavasiddher vedārthasmaraṇasya vedamūlataivāvaiṣyate | na hi vedavidāṃ kāryārthaviṣayaṃ smaraṇaṃ[20] saṃbhavati | vedasya ca mūlatvena mūlāntarakalpanāyā anavasaraḥ |
analyzed: tat api na tatra api pūrva jñāna sāpekṣa tvāt smaraṇasya bhrānti vipralambha ādīnām mahājana parigraha ādinā nirasta tvāt atīndriya artha darśanasya aśakya bhāvāt ca puruṣasya ca sva anubhava siddheḥ veda artha smaraṇasya veda mūla tā eva avaiṣyate na hi veda vidām kārya artha viṣayam smaraṇam saṃbhavati vedasya ca mūla tvena mūla antara kalpanāyāḥ anavasaraḥ

original: nāpy etad yujyate vaktum: "smṛtiśīle ca tadvidām" ity etad apy anūdyate, bāhyasmṛtīnām aprāmāṇyāya, yatas tāsāṃ nyāyata eva siddham aprāmāṇyam | na hi śākyabhojakakṣapaṇakādīnāṃ vedasaṃyogasaṃbhavaḥ, yena tanmūlatayā svaviṣaye pramāṇaṃ syuḥ, svayam anabhyupagamāt, taiś ca vedasyāprāmāṇyābhidhānāt, pratyakṣavedaviruddhārthopadeśāc ca | tatrāsaṃbhavas tāsu smṛtiṣu vedādhyayananiṣedhāt | sati hi vedādhyetṛtve buddhādīnāṃ tanmūlatā syān na veti jāyate vicāraṇā | yatra tu tatsaṃbandho dūrāpetas tatra kā tanmūlatāśaṅkā | svayaṃ ca mūlāntaraṃ paraṃparāyātam abhyupagacchanti: "paśyāmy ahaṃ bhikṣukānāṃ divyena cakṣuṣā sugatiṃ durgatiṃ ca" |[21] evaṃ sarva eva bāhyā bhojakapāñcarātrikanirgranthānārthavādapāśupataprabhṛtayaḥ svasiddhāntānāṃ praṇetṝn puruṣātiśayān devatāviśeṣāṃś ca pratyakṣatadarthadarśino 'bhyupayanti, na vedamūlam api dharmam abhimanyante | pratyakṣeṇa ca vedena viruddhās tatrārthā upadiśyante | tathā hi, hiṃsā ced dharma ucyate saṃsāramocakādibhiḥ, sā cātra pratyakṣataḥ pratiṣiddhā | tathānyatra tīrthasnānam adharmo 'bhyupeyate, iha tu "ahar ahaḥ snāyat," "tīrthāni seveta" iti ca vidhiḥ | tathāgniṣṭomīyavadhaḥ kvacit pāpahetur iṣyate, sa ca jyotiṣṭomavidhinā viruddhaḥ | tathānye sarvān eva yāgahomān ātmārthān saṃmanyante, devatābhedavidhibhir nānādaivatyās te 'vagamitāḥ | ato virodhaḥ |

original: ucyate | anayaivāśaṅkayākhilagrahaṇaṃ kṛtam, yataḥ sarveṣām eteṣāṃ dharmapratipādanaparatvam | tathā hi, arthavādā naiva vidhāyakebhyo vākyebhyaḥ pṛthagarthāḥ yena dharmaṃ na pramimīran | vibhajyamānasākāṅkṣatve vidhiparatvāvagamāt, tatparatve ca siddhāyām ekavākyatāyāṃ, yathā tadarthānuguṇyaṃ pratipadyante tathā vyākhyeyāḥ | ataḥ prajāpater vapotkhādanavacanaṃ na svārthaniṣṭham | kiṃ tarhi, vidhiśeṣam | na ca vidheyaṃ dravyaguṇādi arthavādebhyaḥ pratīyata iti prakārāntareṇa vidheyārthastāvakatvena taccheṣatāṃ pratipadyante | tad api tatra pratīyata eva | itthaṃ nāma paśuyāgaḥ kartavyo yad asatsu paśuṣu gatyantrābhāvāt prajāpatinātmaiva puśutvena kalpito vapā cotkhinnā | yatas tatsahitāny eva vidhāyakāni yatrārthavādāḥ santi | yady api tair vināpi bhavati vidhyarthāvagatiḥ, vidhyuddeśād eva "vasantāya kapiñjalān ālabhate" (MS 3.14.1) iti, tathāpi na teṣām ānarthakyam | teṣu hi satsu na kevalād avagatiḥ | na ca kenacit kṛto vedaḥ, yenocyate "yathānyatra na santi tathātrāpi mā bhūvan" | satsv arthavādeṣv asmābhir gatir vaktavyā | sā coktā | na cayam alaukiko 'rthaḥ | loke 'pi hi stutipadāni dṛśyante vidhiśeṣabhūtāny eva | yathā bhṛtidāne pravṛttasya svāminaḥ kaścid bhṛtakaḥ prītyācaṣṭe "sādhur devadatto nityasaṃnihitaḥ paricaryābhūmijñas tatparaś ca" iti | ato vidheyārthastutidvāreṇārthavādā vidhāyakā eva | tathā kvacid arthavādād eva vidheyaviśeṣāvagatiḥ | yathā "aktāḥ śarkarā upadadhāti" (TB 3.12.5.12) | atra hy añjanasādhanaṃ sarpistailādi yatkiṃcid vidhināpekṣitam | "tejo vai ghṛtam" (AitB 8.20) ity arthavāde ghṛtastutyā ghṛtam adhyavasīyate | evam "pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā rātrīr upayanti" (cf. TāṇB 23.2.4) iti rātriṣv arthavādād adhikārāvagamaḥ | tasmād arthavādā api dharmamūlam |

original: ucyate | iha sadācāro na śrutiḥ, na smṛtiḥ, nibandhābhāvāt | nibaddhākṣarā hi smṛtayaḥ prasiddhāḥ | atas tasya smṛtitvam upapādayati | yat kāryaṃ dharmaṃ śāsty arthaṃ[65] tad dharmaśāstram | yatra dharmaḥ śiṣyate kartavyatayā pratīyate sā smṛtiḥ | nibandhānibandhāv aprayojakau | śiṣṭasamācārād api dharmasya kartavyatāvagatiḥ | so 'pi smṛtir eva | tataś ca yatra kasmaicit kāryāya smṛter upādānaṃ tatra sadācāro 'pi grahītavyaḥ |
analyzed: ucyate iha sat ācāraḥ na śrutiḥ na smṛtiḥ nibandha abhāvāt nibaddha akṣarāḥ hi smṛtayaḥ prasiddhāḥ atas tasya smṛti tvam upapādayati yat kāryam dharmam śāsti artham tat dharma śāstram yatra dharmaḥ śiṣyate kartavya tayā pratīyate sā smṛtiḥ nibandha anibandhau aprayojakau śiṣṭa samācārāt api dharmasya kartavya tā avagatiḥ sā u pi smṛtiḥ eva tatas ca yatra kasmaicid kāryāya smṛteḥ upādānam tatra sat ācāraḥ u pi grahītavyaḥ

original: dharmaśāstraṃ cet smṛtir vedo 'pi sarvamukhyaṃ dharmaśāsanam iti tasyāpi smṛtitvaprasaṅgaḥ | tannivṛttyartham āha: śrutis tu vedo vijñeyaḥ | yatra śrūyate dharmānuśāsanaśabdaḥ sā śrutiḥ | yatra ca smaryate sā smṛtiḥ | tac ca samācāre 'py astīty ataḥ so 'pi smṛtir eva | na hi tatrāpy asmṛtavaidike śabde prāmāṇyam |
analyzed: dharma śāstram ced smṛtiḥ sarva mukhyam dharma śāsanam iti tasya api smṛti tva prasaṅgaḥ tad nivṛtti artham āha śrutiḥ tu vedaḥ vijñeyaḥ yatra śrūyate dharma anuśāsana śabdaḥ sā śrutiḥ yatra ca smaryate sā smṛtiḥ tat ca samācāre pi asti iti atas smṛtiḥ eva na hi tatra api asmṛta vaidike śabde prāmāṇyam

original: naiṣa doṣaḥ | syenavad etad bhaviṣyati | śyenam abhicaran karoty abhicaryamāṇaś ca mriyate | athocyate kāmina evaitat phalam | śatrumaraṇaṃ hi yajamānaḥ kāmayate | tad eva prāpnotīti nākartṛgāmitā phalasya | atrāpi viśiṣṭaputravattālakṣaṇam upanetur eva phalam | yathā putrasyārogyeṇa pituḥ prītiḥ, evaṃ brahmavarcasenāpy ato 'dhikṛtasya kartuś ca tatphalam anvayānusārī hi śāstrārthāvasāyaḥ | iha ca putrasya phalakāmenaivaṃ kartavyam ity anvayaḥ pratīyate | na ca yathāśrutānvayatyāge[169] kiṃcana pramāṇam asti | etena pitur aurdhavdehikaḥ putrakṛta upakāro vyākhyātaḥ | tatrāpi hi putraḥ kartā pitṛtṛptiś ca phalam | tathā ca liṅgaṃ "atmā vai putranāmāsi" (PārG 1.16.18) iti | pitraiva hi tāvac chrāddham ātmasaṃpradānakaṃ vastutaḥ kṛtam eva yenāpatyotpādanam evamartham eva kṛtam | yathā sarvasvāre mṛtasyārbhakāvamānāt ye parāñcaḥ padārthās teṣv api yajamānasyaiva kartṛtvam | "brāhmaṇāh saṃsthāpayata yajñam" it praiṣeṇa, dakṣiṇābhir varaṇena vā prayogasamāptāv ṛtvijāṃ viniyoktṛtvāt, evam ihāpi tādarthyena putrasyotpādanāt, yac chrāddhādikaṃ pitrarthaṃ kriyate pitraiva tatkṛtaṃ bhavati | adhyayanavijñānasaṃpannaṃ brahmavarcasam |
analyzed: na eṣa doṣaḥ syena vat etat bhaviṣyati śyenam abhicaran karoti abhicaryamāṇaḥ ca mriyate atha ucyate kāminaḥ eva etat phalam śatru maraṇam hi yajamānaḥ kāmayate tat eva prāpnoti iti na a kartṛ gāmi tā phalasya atra api viśiṣṭa putravat tā lakṣaṇam upanetuḥ eva phalam yathā putrasya ārogyeṇa pituḥ prītiḥ evam brahmavarcasena api atas dhikṛtasya kartuḥ ca tad phalam anvaya anusārī hi śāstra artha avasāyaḥ iha ca putrasya phala kāmena evam kartavyam

original: kṣatriyasya punar jyā dhanurguṇaḥ | sā kadācic carmamayī bhavati, kadācit tṛṇamayī, bhaṅgomādirajjur vā | tadartham āha maurvīti | tayā dhanuṣo 'vatāritayā śroṇībandhaḥ kartavyaḥ | yady api trivṛttādir guṇo mekhalāmātrāśrito mauñjyā eva, tathāpi jyāyāḥ svarūpanāśaprasaṅgān na bhavati |

original: śaṇatantuvikāraḥ śaṇatāntavī | chāndasatvād uttarapadavṛddhiḥ | atha vā kevalāt tantuśabdāt taddhite kṛte tadantasya śaṇaiḥ saṃbandhaḥ: śaṇānāṃ tāntavīti | prakṛter[182] vikāraḥ śaṇatāntavī prakṛtisaṃbandhitayā vyapadiśyate | "gavyaṃ ghṛtam" "devadattasya pautraḥ" iti | tantuḥ sūtraṃ śaṇamauñjīvat kartavyā | gṛhyakārair vaiśyamekhalāyāḥ trivṛttādidharmaḥ suspaṣṭa evoktaḥ || 2.42 ||
analyzed: śaṇa tantu vikāraḥ śaṇa tāntavī chāndasa tvāt uttara pada vṛddhiḥ atha vā kevalāt tantu śabdāt taddhite kṛte tad antasya śaṇaiḥ saṃbandhaḥ śaṇānām tāntavī iti prakṛteḥ vikāraḥ śaṇa tāntavī prakṛti saṃbandhi tayā vyapadiśyate gavyam ghṛtam devadattasya pautraḥ iti tantuḥ sūtram śaṇa mauñjī vat kartavyā gṛhya kāraiḥ vaiśya mekhalāyāḥ trivṛt tā ādi dharmaḥ su spaṣṭaḥ eva uktaḥ

analyzed: ādi śabda lopam atra smaranti muñja ādi alābhe iti kartavyāḥ iti ca bahuvacanam upapannataram bhinna jāti saṃbandhi tayā su vyaktaḥ mekhalā bhedaḥ eka jāti saṃbandhi tve tu kevala vyakti bheda ālambanam bahuvacanam syāt viprasya iti ca prakṛtasya bahuvacanena pariṇāmaḥ kartavyaḥ vikalpaḥ ca eka viṣaya tve syāt na ca saṃbhavatyām gatau vikalpaḥ yuktaḥ

original: tena muñjābhāve kauśī | jyāyā abhāve 'śmantakena | śāṇānāṃ balvajaiḥ| tṛṇauṣadhivacanāt kuśādayaḥ | pratinidhiniyamaś cāyam | kuśādyabhāve 'py anyan muñjādisadṛśam upādeyam |
analyzed: tena muñja abhāve kauśī jyāyāḥ abhāve śmantakena śāṇānām balvajaiḥ tṛṇauṣadhi vacanāt kuśa ādayaḥ pratinidhi niyamaḥ ca ayam kuśa ādi abhāve pi anyat muñja ādi sadṛśam upādeyam

original: trivṛttā granthinaikena | nāyaṃ granthisaṃkhyābhedo varṇabhedena | api tu pratyekaṃ vikalpaḥ | kuśādimekhalāsv apy ayaṃ granthibhedo dharmabhedaś codyamānaḥ smṛtyantarasamācārasyānityatve 'pi draṣṭavyaḥ || 2.43 ||
analyzed: tri vṛttā granthinā ekena na ayam granthi saṃkhyā bhedaḥ varṇa bhedena api tu pratyekam vikalpaḥ kuśa ādi mekhalāsu api ayam granthi bhedaḥ dharma bhedaḥ codyamānaḥ smṛti antara samācārasya anitya tve draṣṭavyaḥ

original: niṣkāmasya prāṅmukhasya bhojanaṃ vihitaṃ nityatayā | idānīṃ kāmyā vidhaya ucyante | āyuṣe hitaṃ āyuṣyaṃ prāṅmukho bhuṅkta iti | yadi tadbhojanād āyuḥ prāpyate tata āyuṣyaṃ tad bhavati, tenāyam arthaḥ saṃpadyate: āyuṣkāmaḥ prāṅmukho bhuñjīta[194] | adhikāradvayaṃ prācyām, nityaṃ kāmyaṃ ca | āyuṣkāmaḥ phalam abhisaṃdadhīta | itaras tu na tatheti | yathā nityam agnihotram, svargakāmasya cāsakṛtprayogāt tantreṇa phalakāmasya nityo 'py adhikāro nirvartate | evaṃ yaśaḥkāmo dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ | ime kāmyā eva vidhayaḥ | śriyam icchan | śriyan kyajantācchatā kṛtaḥ | śriyai hitaṃ vā śriyam iti makārāntaḥ pāṭhaḥ, āyuṣyādivat | prāṇyaṅgatvāt svārthe bhujir vartate | tathā[195] ṛtaṃ[196] bhuṅkta iti | śriyaṃ bhojanāt prāpnotīti | tathā ca dvitīyāntaḥ pāṭhaḥ śriyam iti | tādarthye vā caturthī "śriyai pratyag" iti | ṛtaṃ satyaṃ yajñaś ca, tatphalaṃ vā svargaḥ | svargakāma udaṅmukho bhuñjīta | antareṇāpi vidhipratyayam aprāptatvād vidhyarthāvagatiḥ pañcamalakārādikalpanayā | evam etad digvibhāgena bhojanaṃ phalaviśeṣārtham |
analyzed: niṣkāmasya prāc mukhasya bhojanam vihitam nitya tayā idānīm kāmyāḥ vidhayaḥ ucyante āyuṣe hitam āyuṣyam prāc mukhaḥ bhuṅkte iti yadi tad bhojanāt āyuḥ prāpyate tatas āyuṣyam tat bhavati tena ayam arthaḥ saṃpadyate āyuṣkāmaḥ prāc mukhaḥ bhuñjīta adhikāra dvayam prācyām nityam kāmyam ca āyuṣkāmaḥ phalam abhisaṃdadhīta itaraḥ tu na tathā iti yathā nityam agnihotram svarga kāmasya ca asakṛt prayogāt tantreṇa phala kāmasya nityaḥ u pi adhik

original: vidigbhojanaṃ tv arthaprāptaṃ nityena prāṅmukhatāniyamenāpodyate | ayaṃ ca kāmyo vidhir na brahmacāriṇa eva bhaikṣyabhojanaviṣayaḥ, api tu gṛhasthādīnām api bhojanamātrāśritaḥ | tathā cāśnīyād iti prakṛte bhuṅkta ity ākhyātāntaranirdeśo liṅgam | itarathāśnīyād iti yato niḥsaṃdigdhā prakṛtaviṣayatā pratīyate tad eva niradaikṣyat | bhuṅkta iti tu nirdeśe kiṃ prakṛta evārthaḥ śabdāntareṇa nirdiṣṭaḥ, uta śabdārthatayā bhojanamātram iti saṃdehe ākhyātāvṛttāv arthāntarāvagatir na prakṛtapratyabhijñānam eva |
analyzed: vidiś bhojanam tu artha prāptam nityena prāc mukha tā niyamena apodyate ayam ca kāmyaḥ vidhiḥ na brahmacāriṇaḥ eva bhaikṣya bhojana viṣayaḥ api tu gṛhastha ādīnām api bhojana mātra āśritaḥ tathā ca aśnīyāt iti prakṛte bhuṅkte iti ākhyāta antara nirdeśaḥ liṅgam itarathā aśnīyāt iti yatas niḥsaṃdigdhā prakṛta viṣaya tā pratīyate tat eva niradaikṣyat bhuṅkte iti tu nirdeśe kim prakṛtaḥ eva arthaḥ śabda antareṇa nirdiṣṭaḥ uta śabda

original: yat tu vidhipratyayābhāvād arthavāda evāyaṃ pūrvaśeṣa iti coktaḥ parihāraḥ vacanāni tv apūrvatvād iti | na ca pūrvaikavākyatāhetur vibhajyamānasākāṅkṣatvādir asti | yady apy uttareṣāṃ caitad avarodhīty anenātideśena brahmacāridharmo 'pi puruṣamātraviṣayaḥ syāt phalaṃ tu na syāt | guṇakāmanāyāṃ hi nātideśāt pravṛttim anumanyante | "godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet" (ĀśŚ 1.16.2), "khādiraṃ vīryakāmasya" (ṢaḍB 4.4) iti vikṛteṣu neṣyate kaiścit || 2.52 ||
analyzed: yat tu vidhi pratyaya abhāvāt artha vādaḥ eva ayam pūrva śeṣaḥ iti ca uktaḥ parihāraḥ vacanāni tu apūrva tvāt iti na ca pūrva eka vākyatā hetuḥ vibhajyamāna sākāṅkṣatva ādiḥ asti yadi api uttareṣām ca etat avarodhi iti anena atideśena brahmacāri dharmaḥ pi puruṣa mātra viṣayaḥ syāt phalam tu na syāt guṇa kāmanāyām hi na atideśāt pravṛttim anumanyante godohanena paśu kāmasya praṇayet khādiram vīrya kāmasya iti vikṛteṣu na iṣyate kaiścid

original: upaspṛśya dvijo nityam annam adyāt samāhitaḥ |
analyzed: upaspṛśya dvijaḥ nityam annam adyāt samāhitaḥ

original: bhuktvā copaspṛśet samyag adbhiḥ khāni ca saṃspṛśet || 2.53 ||
analyzed: bhuktvā ca upaspṛśet samyak adbhiḥ khāni ca saṃspṛśet

original: ācamanopaspṛśatiśabdau samānārthau śuddhyarthasaṃskāraviśeṣavacanau śiṣṭavyavahārād avagamyete | yady upaspṛśatir arthāntare paṭhitaś camur apy adanamātre tathāpi viśeṣa eva sopasargayoḥ prayogadarśanāt tadarthataiva pratīyate | spṛśeḥ sāmānyaviṣayatve 'pi prayogo niyāmakaḥ | gaḍir vadanaikadeśe paṭhyate | sa ca kapola eva gaṇḍa iti prayujyate, naikadeśāntare | "puṣyasiddhyau" (Pāṇ 3.1.116) nakṣatramātre paṭhyete, viśeṣe ca vartete | dhāyyāśabdaḥ sāmidhenīmātre paṭhyate, āvāpikīṣu ca vartate | ato 'pa evācamyety arthaḥ | sa evopaspṛśyety asyāpi[197] | sa ca parastād vidhāyiṣyate | sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ cānayor dṛśyate nityakālam upaspṛśed ity abhidhāya trir ācāmed ity āha | ataḥ samārārthaḥ |
analyzed: ācamana upaspṛśati śabdau samāna arthau śuddhi artha saṃskāra viśeṣa vacanau śiṣṭa vyavahārāt avagamyete yadi upaspṛśatiḥ artha antare paṭhitaḥ camuḥ api adana mātre tathā api viśeṣaḥ eva sa upasargayoḥ prayoga darśanāt tad artha tā eva pratīyate spṛśeḥ sāmānya viṣaya tve pi prayogaḥ niyāmakaḥ gaḍiḥ vadana eka deśe paṭhyate sa ca kapolaḥ eva gaṇḍaḥ iti prayujyate na eka deśa antare puṣya siddhyau nakṣatra mātre paṭhyete viśe

original: ukte 'py ācamyeti bhojanārthatayācamane punarvacanam ānantaryārtham, anantaram eva bhuñjīta, na vyāpārāntareṇa vyavadadhīta | tathā ca bhagavān vyāsaḥ:
analyzed: ukte pi ācamya iti bhojana arthatayā ācamane punarvacanam ānantarya artham anantaram eva bhuñjīta na vyāpāra antareṇa vyavadadhīta tathā ca bhagavān vyāsaḥ

analyzed: pañca ārdrāḥ bhuñjate nityam teṣu vatsyāmi aham hare

original: śrīḥ kilaivam āha | dvau hastau dvau ca pādāv āsyaṃ ca eṣā pañcārdratā | sā[198] copasparśanāntaraṃ bhuñjānasya bhavati, na vilambamānasya | ihāpi vakṣyaty "ārdrapādas tu bhuñjīta" (MDh 4.76) iti snātakavrateṣu | tasyāpaunaruktyaṃ ca vakṣyāmaḥ | nityagrahaṇaṃ prakaraṇād brahmacārībhojanadharmo[199] mā vijñāyi, bhojanamātradharmo yathā syād upadeśata eva |
analyzed: śrīḥ kila evam āha dvau hastau dvau ca pādau āsyam ca  eṣā pañca ārdra tā sā SNF ca upasparśana antaram bhuñjānasya bhavati na  vilambamānasya iha api  vakṣyati ārdra pādaḥ tu  bhuñjīta SPr3O iti snātaka vrateṣu tasya apaunaruktyam SANe ca vakṣyāmaḥ nitya grahaṇam prakaraṇāt brahmacārī bhojana dharmaḥ 199 mā vijñāyi bhojana mātra dharmaḥ yathā syāt U upadeśataḥ eva

original: atra dvijagrahaṇaṃ bhoktṛmātradharmārthaṃ cāhuḥ nityagrahaṇaṃ cānuvādam | na te samyaṅ manyante | yadi dvijaśabdaḥ prakṛte brahmacāriṇi na samāviśet tadā syād api | yadā tu tasyāpy etad abhidhānaṃ tadā nāntareṇa nityagrahaṇaṃ prakaraṇabādhopalabhyate |
analyzed: atra dvija grahaṇam bhoktṛ mātra dharma artham ca āhuḥ nitya grahaṇam ca anuvādam na te samyak manyante yadi dvija śabdaḥ prakṛte brahmacāriṇi na samāviśet tadā syāt api yadā tu tasya api etat abhidhānam tadā na antareṇa nitya grahaṇam prakaraṇa bādhā upalabhyate

original: samāhitaḥ | bhujyamānaṃ dravyaṃ svātmaśaktiṃ cāvekṣamāṇaḥ | anyacetaskasya hi guruviruddhavidāhivarjanaṃ[200] sātmyabhojanaṃ ca na syāt | bhuktvā copaspṛśet | snehādilepāpanayanaṃ dravyaśuddhāv uktam | kṛte tasmin bhuktavata idam ācamanaṃ vidhīyate |
analyzed: samāhitaḥ bhujyamānam dravyam sva ātma śaktim ca avekṣamāṇaḥ anya cetaskasya hi guru viruddha vidāhi varjanam sātmya bhojanam ca na syāt bhuktvā ca upaspṛśet sneha ādi lepa apanayanam dravya śuddhau uktam kṛte tasmin bhuktavataḥ idam ācamanam vidhīyate

original: pūjayed aśanaṃ nityam adyāc caitad akutsayan |
analyzed: pūjayet aśanam nityam adyāt ca etat a kutsayan

original: dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyet pasīdec ca pratinandec ca sarvaśaḥ || 2.54 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā hṛṣyet ca pratinandet ca sarvaśas

original: aśyata ity aśanaṃ bhaktasaktvapūpādy[202] ucyate | tad aśanārtham ānītaṃ devatārūpeṇa paśyet: "eṣā vai paramā devatā yad annam" | tasya sarveṣāṃ bhūtānāṃ sraṣṭṛtvena sthitihetutayā ca yaddarśanaṃ sāsya pūjā | atha vā prāṇārthatvena bhāvanaṃ dhyāyan:[203] "yajan mama yad arthatvaṃ saṃpūjayati māṃ sadā" iti | namaskārādinā vā praṇamya grahaṇaṃ pūjā |
analyzed: aśyate iti aśanam bhakta saktu apūpa ādi ucyate tat aśana artham ānītam devatā rūpeṇa paśyet eṣā vai paramā devatā yat annam tasya sarveṣām bhūtānām sraṣṭṛ tvena sthiti hetutayā ca yat darśanam sā asya pūjā atha vā prāṇa artha tvena bhāvanam dhyāyan yajan mama yat artha tvam saṃpūjayati mām sadā iti namaskāra ādinā vā praṇamya grahaṇam pūjā

original: adyāc caitad akutsayan | kadannatayā duḥsaṃskāropagrahaṇena vā kutsāhetusaṃbhave nānnaṃ kutsayet | "kim idam aśyate, arucikaraṃ dhātuvaiṣamyajanakam" ity evamādinābhidhānena nākṣipet | yadi tu tadrūpaṃ bhavati tadā nādyān na kutsayann adyāt |
analyzed: adyāt ca etat a kutsayan kadanna tayā duḥsaṃskāra upagrahaṇena vā kutsā hetu saṃbhave na annam kutsayet kim idam aśyate aruci karam dhātu vaiṣamya janakam iti evamādinā abhidhānena na ākṣipet yadi tu tad rūpam bhavati tadā na adyāt na kutsayan adyāt

original: dṛṣṭvaiva hṛṣyet | putrastryādisaṃdarśanena cirapravāsapratyagata iv tuṣyeta prīyeta | prasīdec ca | nimittāntarajam api kāluṣyam annadarśanena hitvā manaḥprasādam āśrayet | pratinandec ca | samṛddhyā śaṃsanaṃ pratinandanam | "nityayuktā etena syāma" ity ādaropadarśanam abhinandanam | sarvaśaḥ sarvadā | "anyatarasyām" iti vyavasthitavibhāṣāvijñānāt saptamyarthe śam kartavyaḥ | sarvadeti vā paṭhitavyam || 2.54 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā eva hṛṣyet putra strī ādi saṃdarśanena cira pravāsa pratyagataḥ iv tuṣyeta prīyeta prasīdet ca nimitta antara jam api kāluṣyam anna darśanena hitvā manaḥ prasādam āśrayet pratinandet ca samṛddhyā śaṃsanam pratinandanam nitya yuktāḥ etena syāmaḥ iti ādara upadarśanam abhinandanam sarvaśas sarvadā anyatarasyām iti vyavasthita vibhāṣā vijñānāt saptamī arthe śam kartavyaḥ sarvadā iti vā paṭhitavyam

original: pūrvavidhiśeṣo 'yam arthavādaḥ, na tu phalavidhiḥ | phalavidhau[204] hi kāmyo 'yaṃ vidhiḥ syād ūrjakāmasya balakāmasya ca | tataś ca nityaśabdo nopapadyeta pūjitaṃ hy aśanaṃ nityam iti | ato 'yaṃ yāvajjīvikaḥ prāṅmukhatā niyamaḥ | apūjitaṃ bhuktaṃ hy ubhayaṃ nāśayed balam ūrjaṃ ca | balaṃ sāmarthyam anāyāsena bhārodyamanādiśaktatā | kṛśasyāpy ūrjaṃ mahāprāṇatā | aṅgopacayaḥ mahākāyo mahābalaś ca bhavati || 2.55 ||
analyzed: pūrva vidhi śeṣaḥ yam arthavādaḥ na tu phala vidhiḥ phala vidhau hi kāmyaḥ yam vidhiḥ syāt ūrja kāmasya bala kāmasya ca tatas ca nitya śabdaḥ na upapadyeta pūjitam hi aśanam nityam iti atas yam yāvajjīvikaḥ prāc mukha tā niyamaḥ apūjitam bhuktam hi ubhayam nāśayet balam ūrjam ca balam sāmarthyam anāyāsena bhāra udyamana ādi śakta tā kṛśasya api ūrjam mahā prāṇa tā aṅga upacayaḥ mahā kāyaḥ mahā balaḥ ca bhavati

original: brahmaśabdo 'yam anekārtho 'py adhyayanādhikārād atra vedavacanaḥ pratīyate | tasyārambhe | nimittasaptamy eṣā | adhyayanādhikārād eva ca tadviṣayādhyayanakriyā, tasyāyam ārambhaḥ, prathamāvṛttiḥ puruṣasya | tatredaṃ pādagrahaṇam | vedasya tu yāny ādyakṣarāṇi "agnim īḷe" (RV 1.1.1), "iṣe tvā" (TS 1.1.1.1), "agna āyāhi" (SV 1.1) iti, na so 'trārambha ucyate | na hi tasya nimittabhāvaḥ saṃbhāvitaḥ, nityatvāt | kādācitkaṃ hi nimittaṃ bhavati | tenaitad uktaṃ bhavati: vedādhyayanam āripsamāno guroḥ pādasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāt, kṛtvā tataḥ svādhyāyākṣarāny uccārayet, na punaḥ pravṛttādhyayanakriyaḥ pādau gṛhṇīyāt |
analyzed: brahma śabdaḥ yam adhyayana adhikārāt atra veda vacanaḥ pratīyate tasya ārambhe nimitta saptamī eṣā adhyayana adhikārāt eva ca tad viṣayā adhyayana kriyā tasya ayam ārambhaḥ prathama āvṛttiḥ puruṣasya tatra idam pāda grahaṇam vedasya tu yāni ādi akṣarāṇi agnim īḍe cc-11 iṣe tvā agne āyāhi SPr2Im iti na saḥ u tra ārambhaḥ ucyate na hi tasya nimitta bhāvaḥ saṃbhāvitaḥ nitya tvāt kādācitkam hi nimittam bhavati tena etat uktam bhavati veda adhyayana

original: nanu cādyakriyākṣaṇa ārambhaḥ, sa ca nimittam | vidyamānasya ca nimittatvaṃ yuktaṃ jīvanasyeva | atra gehadāhādyatītam api nimittaṃ tatra tathaiva śravaṇam | tasmāt sahaprayoga evādhyayanapādopasaṃgrahaṇayor yuktaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ca ādya kriyā kṣaṇe ārambhaḥ sa ca nimittam vidyamānasya ca nimitta tvam yuktam jīvanasya iva atra geha dāha ādi atītam api nimittam tatra tathā eva śravaṇam tasmāt saha prayogaḥ eva adhyayana pāda upasaṃgrahaṇayoḥ yuktaḥ

original: ucyate | adhyāpanādhyavasāya ārambha ucyate, nādyaḥ kriyākṣaṇaḥ | yadaiva gurur adhīṣyety āha tadaivādhyavasyati mānavakaḥ | atas tadanantaraṃ pādopagrahaḥ | upakārapravṛttasya guroś cittaprasādanam etat | yathā loke kaścid upakārapravṛttaṃ sabhājayati vācā "nanu tvayā vayam asmāt pāpān mocitāḥ" iti | anakṣarā ceyam adhyeṣaṇā "upasanno 'smy adhyayanāya[242]" iti | na hi gurur uparodhyo 'dhyāpayeti | kevalam upasadanam asya kartavyaṃ saṃbodhārtham avasaro 'dhyayanasyeti | ataḥ kṛtopasadanasya vedākṣaroccaraṇam | api ca saṃhatya hastāv adhetavyam ity ucyate | tatrādhīyānaḥ pādopasaṃgrahaṇavidhim atikrameta |
analyzed: ucyate adhyāpana adhyavasāyaḥ ārambhaḥ ucyate na ādyaḥ kriyā kṣaṇaḥ yadā eva guruḥ adhīṣya iti āha tadā eva adhyavasyati mānavakaḥ atas tad anantaram pāda upagrahaḥ upakāra pravṛttasya guroḥ citta prasādanam etat yathā loke kaścid upakāra pravṛttam sabhājayati vācā nanu tvayā vayam asmāt pāpāt mocitāḥ iti anakṣarā ca iyam adhyeṣaṇā upasannaḥ smi adhyayanāya iti na hi guruḥ uparodhyaḥ dhyāpaya iti kevalam upasadanam asya kartavyam saṃbodha

original: avasānaṃ samāptir adhyayanād uparamaḥ | yady api brahmaśabda ārambhe guṇabhūtas tathāpy avasānasya sāpekṣatvāt saṃnihitatvād brahmapadenaiva saṃbandhaḥ pratīyate, anyasyāśrutatvāt | sadāgrahaṇam anvahaṃ bhāviprayogārambhāvasānayor eṣa vidhir yathā syād itarathā ya eva vratādeśānantaro mukhyaprārambhaḥ tatraiva syāt | athānvārambhaṇīyā darśapūrṇamāsārambhe coditā ya evādhānānantarabhāvī darśapūrṇamāsaprayogārambhaḥ tatraiva bhavati, na māsikaprayogārambhe | [243]prātar ārabhya yāvad āhnikaṃ na nivṛttaṃ prapāṭhakadvayamātraparimāṇam, tāvad ekaiva sādhyayanakriyeti | antarā kathaṃcid vicchede 'pi punaḥ pravṛttau nārambhaśabdavācyatāstīti na punaḥ pādopasadanaṃ kriyate | smṛtyantare ca paṭhyate: "pādopagrahaṇaṃ guroḥ prātar anvaham" iti |
analyzed: avasānam samāptiḥ adhyayanāt uparamaḥ yadi api brahma śabdaḥ ārambhe guṇa bhūtaḥ tathā api avasānasya sāpekṣa tvāt saṃnihita tvāt brahma padena eva saṃbandhaḥ pratīyate anyasya aśruta tvāt sadā grahaṇam anvaham bhāvi prayoga ārambha avasānayoḥ eṣa vidhiḥ yathā syāt itarathā yaḥ eva vrata ādeśa anantaraḥ mukhya prārambhaḥ tatra eva syāt atha anvārambhaṇīyā darśa pūrṇamāsa ārambhe coditā yaḥ eva ādhāna anantara bhāvī darśa pūrṇamā

original: saṃhatya saṃlagnau saṃśliṣṭau parasparaṃ kṛtvā adhyeyam | kacchapa[244] iti yaḥ saṃniveśo hastayoḥ prasiddhas tathā kartavyaḥ | sa hi brahmāñjaliḥ | padārthakathanam etat || 2.71 ||
analyzed: saṃhatya saṃlagnau saṃśliṣṭau parasparam kṛtvā adhyeyam kacchapa iti yaḥ saṃniveśaḥ hastayoḥ prasiddhaḥ tathā kartavyaḥ sa hi brahmāñjaliḥ padārtha kathanam etat

original: yad upasaṃgrahaṇaṃ pūrvaśloke guror uktaṃ tad vyatyastapāṇinā kāryam | kīdṛśaḥ punaḥ pāṇyor vyatyāsaḥ kartavya ity ata āha | savyena hastena savyaḥ pādaḥ spraṣṭavyaḥ sparśaḥ kartavyaḥ, na tu ciraṃ nipīḍyāsitavyam | eṣa ca vyatyāso yugapad itaretaradiksaṃcāreṇa hastayor bhavati | agrataḥ sthitena saṃmukhena guror upasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam | tatra vāmo dakṣiṇamārgaṃ nīyate, dakṣiṇo vāmam ity evaṃ savyena savyaḥ spṛṣṭo bhavati, dakṣiṇena ca dakṣiṇa ity eṣa pāṇivyatyāsaḥ |
analyzed: yat upasaṃgrahaṇam pūrva śloke guroḥ uktam tat vyatyasta pāṇinā kāryam kīdṛśaḥ punar pāṇyoḥ vyatyāsaḥ kartavyaḥ iti atas āha savyena hastena savyaḥ pādaḥ spraṣṭavyaḥ sparśaḥ kartavyaḥ na tu ciram nipīḍya āsitavyam eṣa ca vyatyāsaḥ yugapad itaretara diś saṃcāreṇa hastayoḥ bhavati agratas sthitena saṃmukhena guroḥ upasaṃgrahaṇam kartavyam tatra vāmaḥ dakṣiṇa mārgam nīyate dakṣiṇaḥ vāmam iti evam savyena savyaḥ spṛṣṭ

original: atrāpi pūrvoktena nyāyena brahmaṇa ādāv ante ca praṇavaṃ kuryāt | brahmaviṣayāyā adhyayanakriyāyā iti draṣṭavyam | praṇavaśabda oṃkāravacanaḥ | tathā ca vakṣyati: sravaty anoṃkṛtam iti | sarvadāgrahaṇam adhyayanavidhimātradharmo yathā syād itarathā prakaraṇād grahaṇārtha eva brahmacāriṇaḥ syāt | asmiṃs tu sati yo 'py avismaraṇārtho yac ca "ahar ahaḥ svādhyāyam adhīyīta" iti gṛhasthādīnām, tatra sarvatra siddhaṃ bhavati | saṃdhyājapādau tu svaśabdena vidhāsyati: "etad akṣaram etāṃ ca" (MDh 2.78) iti | na cāyaṃ vedadharmo yena yatra kutracid vaidikavākyoccāraṇam ārabheta, tatra prāpnuyāt | ato homamantrajapaśāstrānuvacanayājyādīnām ārambhe nāsti praṇavaḥ, anyatrāpy udāharaṇārthe vaidikavākyavyāhāre | tasmāt sthitaṃ prākaraṇikasvādhyāyādhyayanavidhidharmārthaṃ sarvadāgrahaṇam | praṇavaprayogasyānvāhikārambhārthatā tu nityakālagrahaṇānuvṛttyaiva siddhā |
analyzed: atra api pūrva uktena nyāyena brahmaṇaḥ ādau ante ca praṇavam kuryāt brahma viṣayāyāḥ adhyayana kriyāyāḥ iti draṣṭavyam praṇava śabdaḥ oṃkāra vacanaḥ tathā ca vakṣyati sravati anoṃkṛtam iti sarvadā grahaṇam adhyayana vidhi mātra dharmaḥ yathā syāt itarathā prakaraṇāt grahaṇa arthaḥ eva brahmacāriṇaḥ syāt asmin tu sati a vismaraṇa arthaḥ yat ca ahar ahar svādhyāyam adhīyīta iti gṛhastha ādīnām tatra sarvatra siddham bhavati saṃdhy

original: asyārthavādaḥ sravaty anoṃkṛtam | pūrvaṃ prārambhe anoṃkṛtaṃ brahma sravati | omā kṛtaṃ[249] oṃśabdena saṃskṛtam | sādhanaṃ kṛteti samāsaḥ | atha vā oṃkṛta[250] uccārito yasmin brahmaṇi tad oṃkṛtaṃ sukhāditvāt paranipātaḥ | parastāc ca samāptau | cakāreṇānoṃkṛtam iti saṃbadhyate | sravati viśīryati ity ubhābhyām api naiṣphalyam adhyayanasya pratipādyate | adhītaṃ brahma yasmin karmaṇi viniyujyeta tan niṣphalaṃ bhavatīti nindārthavādaś ca | pākārthaṃ niṣiktasyāprāptapākakṣīrāder avacchidrite bhājane ya itas tato vikṣepaḥ prakṣaraṇaṃ tat sravatīty ucyate | labdhapākasya[251] piṇḍībhūtasya bhogyatāṃ prāptasya yo vināśaḥ sa viśaraṇam || 2.74 ||
analyzed: asya arthavādaḥ sravati anoṃkṛtam pūrvam prārambhe anoṃkṛtam brahma sravati omā kṛtam om śabdena saṃskṛtam sādhanam kṛtā iti samāsaḥ atha vā oṃkṛta uccāritaḥ yasmin brahmaṇi tat oṃkṛtam sukha ādi tvāt para nipātaḥ parastāt ca samāptau cakāreṇa anoṃkṛtam iti saṃbadhyate sravati viśīryati iti ubhābhyām api naiṣphalyam adhyayanasya pratipādyate adhītam brahma yasmin karmaṇi viniyujyeta tat niṣphalam bhavati iti nindā arthavādaḥ ca

original: adūduhad uddhṛtavān iti | yady api tad ity etat pratīkena "tat savitur vṛṇīmahe" (RV 3.82.1) iti vā śakyate sakṣayitum, na tu sā tripadeti | tripadaiva[256] grāhyā | tripadā caiva sāvitrīti | kaśyapādayo 'pi prajāpatayaḥ santi | ato viśinaṣṭi parameṣṭhīti hiraṇyagarbhaḥ | sa hi parame sthāne 'nāvṛttilakṣaṇe sthitaḥ | ādarātiśayārthaṃ caitat sāvitryāḥ | sākṣāt kileyaṃ sarvamukhyena prajāpatinā vedebhyaḥ samuddhṛteti || 2.77 ||

original: atra kaścid āha | nāyaṃ saṃdhyāvidhir aprakaraṇāt | vidhir hi bhavan brahmacāriṇaḥ syāt, tasya prakṛtatvāt | na ca tasya saṃbhavati | iha hi vedavid ity ucyate | na ca tasya prathamopanītasya vedavittvam asti | api ca phalam atra śrūyate: vedapuṇyena yujyate | nityasya saṃdhyopāsanavidhiḥ na phalārthaḥ | na caitad vidmaḥ kim idaṃ vedapuṇyaṃ nāma phalaṃ yena yogo 'yaṃ japa ucyate | yadi tāvad vedādhyayanatvād yat[258] puṇyam abhipretaṃ tadavāptir vedapuṇyena yogo 'bhipretas tatra yaḥ tāvad ayaṃ prakṛtaḥ svādhyāyavidhis tasya nārthāvabodhād ṛte kiṃcit palam asty aśrutatvād dṛṣṭatvāc cārthāvabodhasya kalpanāpi nāsti | yaś ca gṛhasthādīnāṃ vidhiḥ "ahar ahaḥ svādhyāyam adhīyīta" iti, so 'pi nitya eva | yat tatra phalaśravaṇaṃ "payo dadhi ghṛtaṃ madhu" iti, so 'rthavāda eva | tasmān nāyaṃ vidhiḥ | vidhau hi sarvam etad vivakṣitavyam | yadā tv ayam arthavādas tadā japan iti prakṛtam adhyayanam ucyate, vedapuṇyena ity etad api yathākathaṃcin nīyate |
analyzed: atra kaścid āha na ayam saṃdhyā vidhiḥ aprakaraṇāt vidhiḥ hi bhavan brahmacāriṇaḥ syāt tasya prakṛta tvāt na ca tasya saṃbhavati iha hi veda vid iti ucyate na ca tasya prathama upanītasya veda vid tvam asti api ca phalam atra śrūyate veda puṇyena yujyate nityasya saṃdhyā upāsana vidhiḥ na phala arthaḥ na ca etat vidmaḥ kim idam veda puṇyam nāma phalam yena yogaḥ yam japaḥ ucyate yadi tāvat veda adhyayana tvāt yat puṇyam abhipretam tad avāptiḥ veda puṇyen

original: atrocyate | vākyena prakaraṇaṃ bādhyata ity uktam eva | yata eva vedavitpadaṃ saṃdhyāpadaṃ ca na prakṛtaviṣayatayānveti,[259] tata evānyatrāyam vidhiḥ | saṃdhyayor etat trayaṃ japed ity etāvān vidhiḥ | vedavitpadam anuvadiṣyate | gṛhasthādīnāṃ vedavittvasya saṃbhavāt brahmacāriṇo vedavittvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti cet, kiṃ tadīyena saṃbhavena | yathā prāptānuvāde hi sarvāśramiṇām adhikāraḥ | kartṛviśeṣaṇe hi vedavitpade brahmacāriṇo nādhikāraḥ syāt | kathaṃ punar asyānuvādaḥ | vākyabhedaprasaṅgāt | vidhau saṃdhyāvidhau prāpte praṇavavyāhṛtayas tāvad aprāptās tatra vidhātavyāḥ | tatra yady aparaṃ vedavid iti[260] vidhīyate tadā vākyabhedaḥ syāt | prāpte hi karmaṇi nānekārthavidhānaṃ saṃbhavati | praṇavavyāhṛtīnāṃ tu nānuvādaḥ saṃbhavati |
analyzed: atrā ucyate vākyena prakaraṇam bādhyate iti uktam eva yatas eva vedavid padam saṃdhyā padam ca na prakṛta viṣayatayā anveti tatas eva anyatra ayam vidhiḥ saṃdhyayoḥ etat trayam japet iti etāvān vidhiḥ vedavid padam anuvadiṣyate gṛhastha ādīnām vedavid tvasya saṃbhavāt brahmacāriṇaḥ vedavid tvam na saṃbhavati iti ced kim tadīyena saṃbhavena yathā prāpta anuvāde hi sarva āśramiṇām adhikāraḥ kartṛ viśeṣaṇe hi vedavid pade brahmacāriṇaḥ na adhik

original: tenāyam atra vākyārthaḥ | saṃdhyayor yat sāvitrīṃ japed ity uktaṃ tatrāyam aparo guṇaḥ praṇavavyāhṛtipūrvikāṃ tām japet | vipragrahaṇaṃ ca tadā pradarśanārtham eva |
analyzed: tena ayam atra vākya arthaḥ saṃdhyayoḥ yat sāvitrīm japet iti uktam tatra ayam aparaḥ guṇaḥ praṇava vyāhṛti pūrvikām tām japet vipra grahaṇam ca tadā pradarśana artham eva

original: yad apy uktam: phalam atra śrūyate, nityaś cāyaṃ vidhiḥ saṃdhyāyāḥ | ko nāmāyaṃ virodhaḥ | nitya eva tasmin guṇe kāmo bhaviṣyati | praṇavavyāhṛtiguṇakāt tasmād idaṃ phalam iti | yathā godohanapraṇayanakād agnihotrāt paśavaḥ phalam: "godohanena paśukāmasya praṇayet" iti vākyasāmarthyena | adhyetuś caitad uktam, na tv ayaṃ kāmyo vidhiḥ | smṛtyantare hi nitya evāyaṃ vidhiḥ spaṣṭa evoktaḥ:
analyzed: yat api uktam phalam atra śrūyate nityaḥ ca ayam vidhiḥ saṃdhyāyāḥ kaḥ nāma ayam virodhaḥ nityaḥ eva tasmin guṇe kāmaḥ bhaviṣyati praṇava vyāhṛti guṇakāt tasmāt idam phalam iti yathā godohana praṇayanakāt agnihotrāt paśavaḥ phalam godohanena paśu kāmasya praṇayet iti vākya sāmarthyena adhyetuḥ ca etat uktam na tu ayam kāmyaḥ vidhiḥ smṛti antare hi nityaḥ eva ayam vidhiḥ spaṣṭaḥ eva uktaḥ

original: vittādyādhikyenāviduṣo 'pi yathāvidhy abhivādyatāyāṃ prāptāyāṃ tannivṛttyartham idam | ye kecid avidvāṃso nāmadheyasya saṃskṛtasyoccāritasya abhivādam abhivādārtham | abhivāditā etena vayam ity avaiyyākaraṇā na jānatem saṃskṛtaṃ nāvabudhyante, tān prājño nārīś cābhivādyāḥ | ete na saṃskṛtam ucyamānaṃ pratipadyate, tatra vidhyekadeśaṃ svanāmagrahaṇaṃ hitvā "abhivādaye 'ham" ity etāvad eva brūyāt | tad api cen nāvabudhyante, laukikenāpabhraṃśenāpy abhivādyā ity evamarthaṃ prājñagrahaṇam | tadīyām abodhaśaktiṃ jñātvohitavyo 'bhivādaprayogo nopadeśa evādartavyaḥ | striyo 'py[355] evam eva | sarvagrahaṇaṃ gurupatnīnāṃ saṃskṛtaprayogajñānām api |

original: svasya nāmno 'nte bhoḥśabdaṃ kīrtayet | svagrahaṇam abhivādyamānapratiṣedhārtham | pariśiṣṭo 'rthavādaḥ | na ca nāmākṣarāṇām evānte 'pi tu tataḥ pareṣām "aham asmi" iti | eṣa hi tatretikaraṇaṃ prayogāvadhāraṇārtham | evam eva prayoktavyaḥ | api ca "devadatto bho aham" iti duḥśiṣṭe prayoge vilambitāyāṃ pratipattau saṃmukhībhāvaś cireṇa syāt tatra kāryavirodhaḥ | vyavahitasaṃbandhe kaścin naivāvadhānavān syāt |

original: svarūpabhāvaḥ svarūpasya sattā | atha vābhivādyanāmnāṃ svarūpe bhavati, tatsthāne bhavaty atas tannāmanivṛttiḥ | bhāvasādhanaḥ kartṛsādhano vā bhāvaśabdaḥ | svarūpabhāva iti saptamyanto vā paṭhitavyaḥ | bhobhāvaḥ[356] | bho ity etasya yad bhavanaṃ yat svarūpaṃ tan nāmnāṃ svarūpam | yathaiva nāma gṛhītvā kasyacit saṃbodhanaṃ kriyate "devadatta śrūyatām" iti, evaṃ bhoḥśabdo 'py āmantritavibhaktyantaḥ saṃbodhanāyaivaṃ ṛṣibhiḥ smaryate || 2.124 ||

original: akāraś cāsya pratyabhivādyasya yan nāma tadante yo 'kāraḥ sa plutaḥ kartavyaḥ | pluta iti trimātrasya saṃjñā | akāragrahaṇam ikārādīnām api pradarśanārtham | ajapekṣam eva cāntatvaṃ draṣṭavyam | vyajñanāntasyāpi yo 'ntyaḥ svaras tasya bhavati | pūrvākṣara eva plutabhāvino 'kārasya viśeṣaṇam etat | akṣaram atra vyañjanam | tatra pūrvaśliṣṭaḥ[357] sa evam ucyate | etad uktaṃ bhavati | pūrva eva nāgantur akāraḥ plutaḥ kartavyaḥ | kiṃ tarhi, ya eva nāmni vidyate sa eva plāvayitavyaḥ |
analyzed: akāraḥ ca asya pratyabhivādyasya yat nāma tad ante kāraḥ sa plutaḥ kartavyaḥ plutaḥ iti tri mātrasya saṃjñā akāra grahaṇam ikāra ādīnām api pradarśana artham eva ca anta tvam draṣṭavyam yaḥ ntyaḥ svaraḥ tasya bhavati pūrva akṣare eva pluta bhāvinaḥ u kārasya viśeṣaṇam etat akṣaram atra vyañjanam tatra pūrva śliṣṭaḥ saḥ evam ucyate etat uktam bhavati pūrvaḥ eva na āgantuḥ akāraḥ plutaḥ kartavyaḥ kim tarhi yaḥ eva nāmni vidyā anup

analyzed: sarvam ca etat evam vyākhyānam bhagavataḥ pāṇineḥ smṛti sāmarthyena śabda artha prayoge ca manu ādibhyaḥ dhikataraḥ prāmāṇye bhagavān pāṇiniḥ sa ca pratyabhivāde śūdre ṭeḥ plutim smarati ṭi śabdena yaḥ tad ādi śabda rūpam ucyate

original: vipragrahaṇam avivakṣitam | kṣatriyādīnām apy eṣa eva vidhiḥ | smṛtyantarasamācāro hy evam eva sthitaḥ | na caiṣāṃ vidhyantaram asti | atrodāharaṇam "āyuṣmān devadatta3" | vyañjanāntasya "āyuṣmān edhi somaśarma3n" || 2.125 ||

original: bhobhavacchabdaḥ pūrvo yasyābhibhāṣaṇasya tad evam ukte dvayoś caitayoḥ śabdayor ekatra vākye prayogābhāvād vyavasthāṃ vyācakṣate | yadā tena saha saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ bhavati tadāmantritavibhaktyantena bhoḥśabdena saṃbodhyaḥ | yadā tu tadīyaguṇākhyānaṃ parokṣaṃ karoti: "tatrabhavatā dīkṣitenaivaṃ kṛtam," "tatrabhavān evaṃ karoti" ity evaṃ prayoktavyam | bhavad iti ca prātipadikamātram upāttam, yathā vibhaktyā saṃbandham upaiti tadantaṃ prayoktavyam || 2.128 ||

original: arthaprayuktaṃ saṃbhāṣaṇaṃ striyā saha yadā bhavati tadaivaṃ kartavyam | yā tāvat parasya patnī sā "bhavati subhage" atha vā "bhavati bagini" | bhavacchabdo 'yaṃ strīpratyayāntaḥ saṃbuddhau kṛtahrasvaḥ | bhavatīty atretikaraṇaṃ padārthaviparyāsakṛtasvarūpaṃ paraṃ[361] bodhayati, subhage bhaginīty atra prakāre | brūyād ity adhikārāc chabdasvarūpagrahaṇaṃ siddham | ācāryatāyāṃ[362] ca mātar yaśasvini, kanīyasī ca duhitar āyuṣmatīty evamādibhiḥ śabdaiḥ saṃbhāṣyā | patnīgrahaṇāt kanyāyā naiṣa vidhiḥ | asaṃbaddhā ca yonitaḥ | mātṛpakṣapitṛpakṣābhyāṃ yā jñātitvaṃ nāgatā mātuladuhitrādis tāsām anyaṃ vidhiṃ vakṣyati "jñātisaṃbandhiyoṣitaḥ" iti (MDh 2.132) |

original: satyam | yāny ekasyām agnihotrādīny upadiṣṭāni teṣāṃ śākhāntare 'py upadiśyamānānāṃ mā bhūd bhedaḥ[375] | kiṃ tu kasyāṃcic chākhāyāṃ kānicit karmāṇi naivopadiśyante | yathā bāhvṛce āśvalāyanake darśapūrṇamāsau śyenādir ābhicārakaḥ[376], anye ca somayāgavājapeyabṛhaspatisavādayaḥ | tatra yat tacchākhādhīnam agnihotrajyotiṣṭomādi tatrādhikriyate | śākhāntaraṃ tv anadhītam aśrutaṃ kathaṃ tadvihitāni[377] karmāṇy tacchākhādhyāyī vettu | na caite somayāgā nityā, yenānanuṣṭhānapratyavāyabhayāt parijñānāya śākhāntaram anviṣyate | ādhānaṃ tu yady api tatra na paṭhitaṃ tatrāpy "uddharāhavanīyam" (AitB 5.26; ĀśŚ 2.2.1) ity āhavanīyasya vidhānam | lokāt tadartham anavabudhyamānaḥ ko 'yam āhavanīyo yasyādhānam iti śākhāntaram anviṣyati | tataḥ śākhāntare paṭhyamānam ādhānaprakaraṇaṃ sarvaṃ paryālocayati | evam āmāvāsyena vā haviṣeṣṭvā paurṇamāsena veti śrutvā kīdṛśam anayoḥ karmaṇo rūpam iti tathaiva śākhāntaraṃ gaveṣayate | evam anyad api yat kāmyaṃ nityaṃ cānuṣṭheyaṃ tasya yat kiṃcid aṅgajātaṃ tatra nāmnātam ādhvaryavam audgātraṃ vā tat parijñāya tathaiva śākhāntarādhigamaḥ[378] | yat tu śākhāntarādhītam anuṣṭheyaṃ tasya na vedanasaṃbhavaḥ | anekaśākhādhyāyinas tu tadarthaparasya sarvam etat pratyakṣam iti | astīdṛśīṃ vidyām antareṇāpi karmānuṣṭhānam | atha vā īṣadvyutpattyāpi saṃbhavaty anuṣṭhānaṃ |
analyzed: satyam yāni ekasyām agnihotra ādīni upadiṣṭāni teṣām śākhā antare pi upadiśyamānānām mā bhūt bhedaḥ kim tu kasyāṃcid śākhāyām kānicid karmāṇi na eva upadiśyante yathā bāhvṛce āśvalāyanake darśa pūrṇamāsau śyena ādiḥ ābhicārakaḥ anye ca soma yāga vājapeya bṛhaspatisava ādayaḥ tatra yat tad śākhā adhīnam agnihotra jyotiṣṭoma ādi tatra adhikriyate śākhā antaram tu anadhītam aśrutam katham tad vihitāni karmāṇi tad śākhā adhyāyī

original: pañcānām eteṣāṃ mānasthānānāṃ[382] yatra bhūyāṃsi bahūny asarvāṇi sa mānyaḥ | tatra paratvam nātīvādartavyam[383] | ekasya vittabandhū dve anyo vṛddhavayāḥ | tatra pūrve bādhake | saty api bahutve yadi na śreṣṭhāni bhavanti, ekaṃ caikasyātyutkṛṣṭam, tadā sāmyam | na punaḥ parabādhakatvam | garīya ekāpekṣayā caritārthatvāt[384] | yadi tu bhūyāṃsi gunavanty atyutkṛṣṭāni tadā sāmye 'pi saṃkhyayā pareṣāṃ, pūrvāṇi paraiś ca samasaṃkhyāni, tadā na pūrvataratayā[385] bādhyabādhakabhāvaḥ | kiṃ tarhi sāmānyam eva |
analyzed: pañcānām eteṣām mānasthānānām yatra bhūyāṃsi bahūni asarvāṇi sa mānyaḥ tatra paratvam na atīva ādartavyam ekasya vitta bandhū dve anyaḥ vṛddha vayāḥ tatra pūrve bādhake sati api bahutve yadi na śreṣṭhāni bhavanti ekam ca ekasya ati utkṛṣṭam tadā sāmyam na punar para bādhaka tvam garīyaḥ eka apekṣayā caritārtha tvāt yadi tu bhūyāṃsi ati utkṛṣṭāni tadā sāmye saṃkhyayā pareṣām pūrvāṇi paraiḥ ca sama saṃkhyāni tadā saṃkhyayā

original: bhūyāṃsīty ādhikyamātraṃ vivakṣitaṃ na bahutvasaṃkhyaiva | tena dviviṣayatāpi siddhā bhavati | na hy ayaṃ saṃkhyāvācyeva bahuśabda ity atra pramāṇam asti | bhūyaḥśabdaś cāyaṃ na bahuśabda ādhikye ca tatra tatra dṛṣṭaḥ prayogaḥ | "bhūyāṃś cātra parihāraḥ," "bhūyasābhydayena yokṣye" iti pratyayārthabahutvam api na vivakṣitam | "jātyākhyāyām" (Pāṇ 1.2.58) hy etad bahuvacanam | vivakṣāyāṃ hi ekasya guṇavato mānahetutvaṃ na syāt | tataś ca pūrvo 'vagatir bādhyate[387] | śūdro 'pi daśamīm ity atra ca kevalasyaiva vayasaḥ prakarṣe mānahetutvaṃ bruvann avivakṣāṃ darśayati | samācāraś caivam eva || 2.137 ||

analyzed: brahmacāri grahaṇam prakaraṇa antara tvena a tad dharma āśaṅkayā anusaṃdhāna artham yadi brahmacāri dharmaḥ eva āsīt kim tarhi idam ucyate prakaraṇa antaram iti pūrvebhyaḥ eteṣām atiśayāt samāna dharma tvāt etāvatā vailakṣaṇyena prakaraṇa antara tva vyavahāraḥ pariśiṣṭāni padāni śloka pūraṇa artha tayā anūdyante

original: seveta anutiṣṭheta | imān vakṣyamāṇān | buddhau saṃnihitatvād idamā nirdiśyante | gurau vasan gurusamīpe vidyādhyayanārthaṃ vasan iti nityasaṃnidhānam āha[430] | saṃniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ prāguktena mārgeṇa | tapovṛddhyartham adhyayanavidhyanuṣṭhānajanyātmasaṃskārārtham[431] || 2.175 ||
analyzed: seveta anutiṣṭheta imān vakṣyamāṇān buddhau saṃnihita tvāt idamāḥ nirdiśyante gurau vasan guru samīpe vidyā adhyayana artham vasan iti nitya saṃnidhānam āha saṃniyamya indriya grāmam prāc uktena mārgeṇa tapaḥ vṛddhi artham adhyayana vidhi anuṣṭhāna janya ātma saṃskāra artham

original: tānīdānīṃ pūrveṇa pratijñātān niyamān[432] āha |
analyzed: tāni idānīm pūrveṇa pratijñātān niyamān āha

analyzed: devatā abhyarcanam ca eva samidh ādhānam eva ca

original: pratyahaṃ snātvā śuciḥ snānenāpanītāśucibhāvo devarṣipitṛtarpaṇaṃ kuryāt | yadi punaḥ śuciḥ na[433] tadāvaśyaṃ snāyāt | śucigrahaṇena śuddhihetutayātra snānasyopadiṣṭatvān na snātakavratavat tadanuṣṭheyam | ata eva smṛtyantare ca snānaṃ pratiṣiddham | sa pratiṣedho mṛdā snānasya prasādhanalakṣaṇasya | gautamena tu snānam evaṃ vihitam: "daṇda ivāpsu pariplavate" (cf. ĀpDh 1.2.30) | malāpakarṣaṇaṃ karanigharṣaṇādinā na[434] kartavyam | asaty amedhyādisaṃsarge, na yat svedajaṃ vastrareṇusaṃyogādisahajaṃ malaṃ tad aśucitvam āpādayati | tad dhi niyatarūpam eva | tathā ca brāhmaṇaṃ "kiṃ nu malaṃ kim ajinaṃ kim u śmaśrūṇi kiṃ tapaḥ" (AitB 7.13) iti dharmasādhanatām evaṃvidhasya maladhāraṇasya darśayati |
analyzed: pratyaham snātvā śuciḥ snānena apanīta aśuci bhāvaḥ deva ṛṣi pitṛ tarpaṇam kuryāt yadi punar śuciḥ na tadā avaśyam snāyāt śuci grahaṇena śuddhi hetutayā atra snānasya upadiṣṭa tvāt na snātaka vrata vat tat anuṣṭheyam atas eva smṛti antare ca snānam pratiṣiddham sa pratiṣedhaḥ mṛdā snānasya prasādhana lakṣaṇasya gautamena tu snānam evam vihitam mala apakarṣaṇam kara nigharṣaṇa ādinā na kartavyam asati amedhya amedhya amedhya amedhya amed

original: kathaṃ punaḥ snānasya śaucārthatā pratīyate | na punaḥ snātaḥ śuciś cobhayaviśiṣṭo devakārye viniyujyate | snātasyāśucitvābhāvāt, kṛtaśaucācamanādeḥ snānavidhānāt, "snātvā cācāntaḥ punar ācāmet" (VaDh 3.38) iti ca snātasyāpi śucir ity etāvatā yādṛśī suddhis tasyāṃ vijñāyamānāyāṃ snānam api sati nimitte prāptaṃ punar ucyate | smṛtyantaraṃ cedam asaty[435] aśucitve nimitte pratiṣedhārtham | tathā ca "vedam adhītya snāyāt" (BauG 2.5.6) iti samāpte svādhyāyavidhau pratiprasaviṣyati |
analyzed: katham punar snānasya śauca artha tā pratīyate na punar snātaḥ śuciḥ ca ubhaya viśiṣṭaḥ deva kārye viniyujyate snātasya aśuci tva abhāvāt kṛta śauca ācamana ādeḥ snāna vidhānāt snātvā ca ācāntaḥ punar ācām iti ca snātasya api śuciḥ iti etāvatā yādṛśī suddhiḥ tasyām vijñāyamānāyām snānam api sati nimitte prāptam punar ucyate smṛti antaram ca idam asat aśuci tve nimitta pratiṣedha artham tathā ca veda adhītya snāyāt BauGd iti samāpte samā

original: kuryād devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam | udakadānaṃ devādibhyo gṛhasthadharmeṣu yad uktaṃ tādṛśam eva pratīyate, tarpaṇaśabdasāhacaryāt | "yad eva tarpayaty adbhiḥ" (MDh 3.283) iti, tathā "devatās tarpayati" (ĀśG 3.4.1) iti gṛhyakārair udakasādhano 'yaṃ vidhir uktaḥ | udakatarpaṇam iti caitat saṃvijñāyate | te devā gṛhyakāraiḥ paṭhitā agniprajāpatibrahmetyādayaḥ | teṣāṃ ca tarpaṇaṃ na sauhityotpādanam, kiṃ tarhi taduddeśenodakāñjaliprakṣepaḥ | ato 'yam udakadravyako yāga evokto bhavati | na hy anyathā devatātvaṃ bhavati | yāgasaṃpradānaṃ hi seti smaryate, na tṛpteḥ kartrī |
analyzed: kuryāt deva ṛṣi pitṛ tarpaṇam udaka dānam deva Cp ādibhyaḥ gṛhastha dharmeṣu yat SNNe uktam SNPaNe tādṛśam eva pratīyate tarpaṇa śabda sāhacaryāt yat  eva tarpayati SPr3In adbhiḥ PIF iti  tathā  devatāḥ PAF tarpayati SPr3In iti  gṛhya Cp kāraiḥ PIM udaka sādhanaḥ SNM yam SAM vidhiḥ SNM uktaḥ SNPaM udaka tarpaṇam SNNe iti  ca etat SNNe saṃvijñāyate te PNM devāḥ PNM gṛhya Cp kāraiḥ PIM paṭhitāḥ agni Cp prajāpati Cp brahma Cp ityādayaḥ teṣā

original: etāvad dhi devatālakṣaṇam: sūktabhājo havirbhājaś ca devatāḥ | tatra sūktaṃ stutyatayā bhajante, haviḥ saṃpradānatayā | tarpyatvena codakadānasaṃpradānatām eva guṇavṛttyā vakti | gurvādisaṃpradānaṃ gavādinā taduddiśyamānasvāmyena[436] pratīyate | devatāpi saṃpradānabhūtaḥ[437] | saṃpradānatvasāmyāt tṛpyantīty ucyate | yadi devatātṛptyartham etat syāt tadā saṃskārakarmodakatarpaṇaṃ syāt | na ca devatānāṃ saṃskāryatvopapattiḥ | na hi tāḥ kvacid upayuktā upayokṣyante vā | na cākṛtākariṣyamāṇakāryasya[438] saṃskāratopapattiḥ |
analyzed: etāvat hi devatā lakṣaṇam sūkta bhājaḥ haviḥ bhājaḥ ca devatāḥ tatra sūktam stutya tayā bhajante haviḥ saṃpradāna tayā tarpya tvena ca udaka dāna saṃpradāna tām eva guṇa vṛttyā vakti guru ādi saṃpradānam gavādinā tad uddiśyamāna svāmyena pratīyate devatā api saṃpradāna bhūtaḥ saṃpradāna tva sāmyāt tṛpyanti iti ucyate yadi devatā tṛpti artham etat syāt tadā saṃskāra karma udaka tarpaṇam syāt na ca devatānām saṃskārya tva upapattiḥ

original: ṛṣayo ye yasyārṣeyāḥ | yathā parāśarāṇāṃ vasiṣṭhaśaktipāraśaryā iti[439] | gṛhyakārais tu mantradṛśa ṛṣayas tarpaṇīyatvenoktāḥ, madhucchando gṛtsamado viśvāmitra iti | aviśeṣābhidhānād ṛṣiśabdasyobhaye 'pi prāptāḥ | viśeṣasmṛtitvāt gṛhyasmṛtes ta eva grahītuṃ nyāyyāḥ |
analyzed: ṛṣayaḥ ye yasya ārṣeyāḥ yathā parāśarāṇām vasiṣṭha śakti pāraśaryāḥ iti gṛhya kāraiḥ tu mantra dṛśaḥ ṛṣayaḥ tarpaṇīya tvena uktāḥ madhucchandaḥ gṛtsamadaḥ viśvāmitraḥ iti aviśeṣa abhidhānāt ṛṣi śabdasya ubhaye prāptāḥ viśeṣa smṛti tvāt gṛhya smṛteḥ te eva grahītum nyāyyāḥ

original: pitaraḥ pūrvapretāḥ pitṛpitāmahāḥ sapiṇḍāḥ samānodakāś ca | pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tarpaṇam eva | etac ca śrāddhavidhau pratyakṣeṇa vakṣyate |
analyzed: pitaraḥ pūrvapretāḥ pitṛ pitāmahāḥ sapiṇḍāḥ samāna udakāḥ ca pitṝṇām tarpaṇam tarpaṇam eva etat ca śrāddha vidhau pratyakṣeṇa vakṣyate

original: devatābhyarcanam | atra kecic cirantanā vicārayāṃcakruḥ: kā etā devatā nāma yāsām idam abhyarcanam ucyate | yadi tāvac citrapustakanyastaḥ caturbhujo vajrahasta ityādyāḥ, pratikṛtaya iti laukikā vyavaharanti | ato gauṇas tatra devatāvyavahāraḥ | atha yāḥ sūktahaviḥsaṃbandhinyo vaidikībhyaś codanābhyo mantravākyebhyaś cāvagamyante, śabdārthasaṃbandhavidaś ca smaranti "agniḥ agnīṣomau mitrāvaruṇau indro viṣṇuḥ" iti | yady evaṃ tatkriyāsaṃbandhitayaiva teṣāṃ devatātvaṃ nārthasaṃbandhitayā | tatrāpi yasyaiva haviṣo yā devatā tena coditā tasyaiva sā bhavati | tathā hi āgneyo 'ṣṭākapāla ity āgneye puroḍāśe devatā,[440] na saurye carau | ayaṃ ca teṣāṃ nirṇayaḥ: mukhyāsaṃbhavād gauṇasyaiva grahaṇaṃ nyāyyam, samācārāc ca | ataḥ pratimānām evaitat pūjāvidhānam | yac cātra tattvaṃ tad "vratavad devadaivatye" ity atra vakṣyāmaḥ (cf. MDh 2.189) |
analyzed: devatā abhyarcanam atra kecid cirantanāḥ vicārayāṃcakruḥ kāḥ etāḥ devatāḥ nāma yāsām idam abhyarcanam ucyate yadi tāvat citra pustaka nyastaḥ caturbhujaḥ vajrahastaḥ ityādyāḥ pratikṛtayaḥ iti laukikāḥ vyavaharanti atas gauṇaḥ tatra devatā vyavahāraḥ atha yāḥ sūkta haviḥ saṃbandhinyaḥ vaidikībhyaḥ codanābhyaḥ mantra vākyebhyaḥ ca avagamyante śabda artha saṃbandha vidaḥ ca smaranti agniḥ agnīṣomau mitrāvaruṇau indraḥ viṣṇu

analyzed: samidh ādhānam sāyamprātar agnau dāru śakala prakṣepaṇam

analyzed: śuktāni yāni sarvāṇi prāṇinām ca eva hiṃsanam

original: madhu sāragham | mādhvīkasya tu madyatvāt prāg apy upanayanāt pratiṣedho "nityaṃ madyaṃ brāhmaṇo varjayet" (cf. GDh 2.20) iti | māṃsaṃ prokṣitādy api | gandhaśabdena surabhitvātiśayayuktāni karpūrāguruprabhṛtīni dravyāṇi saṃbandhilakṣaṇayā pratiṣidhyante | teṣām anulepanādyupabhogapratiṣedhaḥ | gandhas tu svadeśān nirgata āgacchatīty aśakyo niṣeddhum | tatrāpy ākasmikasyāpy apratiṣedhāt, bhogecchayā tv agurudhūpādau doṣa eva | ata upādhyāyena candanavṛkṣādicchedane niyuktasya tadgandhasyāghrāṇe vastusvabhāvata utpadyamāne na doṣaḥ | mālyasāhacaryāc cedṛśo gandhaḥ pratīyate | yas tu nedṛśo hṛdayonmādakaraḥ kuṣṭhaghṛtapūtidārvādigandhas tasyāpratiṣedhaḥ[441] | mālyaṃ kusumaṃ grathitam | rasāḥ madhurāmlādayaḥ |
analyzed: madhu sāragham mādhvīkasya tu madya tvāt prāk api upanayanāt pratiṣedhaḥ nityam madyam brāhmaṇa varjay SPr3O iti māṃsam prokṣ PaCp ādi api  gandha śabdena surabhi tva atiśaya yuktāni karpūra Cp aguru prabhṛtīni dravyāṇi saṃbandhi lakṣaṇayā pratiṣidh PPr3InPv teṣām anulepana ādi upabhoga pratiṣedhaḥ gandhaḥ tu  sva deśāt nirgataḥ āgacchati iti aśakyaḥ niṣeddhum tatra api ākasmikasya api apratiṣedhāt bhoga icchayā tu  aguru dhūpa ādau doṣaḥ

original: nanu ca nīrasasya bhojyatvāsaṃbavāt prāṇavṛttir eva na syāt | satyam | udriktarasāḥ kevalā guḍādayo niṣidhyante | saṃskārakaraṇe dravyāntargatānām api pratiṣedhaḥ | atha vātyantarasinaḥ saṃskṛtasyānnasya saktipratiṣedho[442] 'yam | yathoktam:

original: anye tu śṛṅgārādīn manyante | nāṭakādiprekṣaṇena kāvyaśravaṇena vā rasapuṣṭir na kartavyā[443] | anyeṣāṃ tu darśanam, ikṣvāmalakādīnāṃ yo 'ntardravarūpodakavat sa rasas tasya niṣpīḍitasya pṛthak kṛtasya[444] pratiṣedho na punas tadantargatasya | tac caitad ayuktam | na hi rasaśabdo dravaparyāyaḥ prasiddhaḥ | yatra ca yasyocitam upabhogāntatvaṃ tad eva tasya niṣidhyate | tena madhumāṃsyor bhojane pratiṣedhaḥ, na darśanasparśanayoḥ | gandhamālyasyāpi sarīramaṇḍanābhimānatayopādānaṃ niṣidhyate, na tu kathaṃcid dhastādinā grahaṇam | evaṃ striyo maithunasaṃbandhena | tadāśaṅkayaiva ca prekaṇālambhau niṣetsyati | tathā ca gautamaḥ: "strīprekṣaṇālambhane maithunaśaṅkāyām" iti (GDh 2.16) |
analyzed: anye tu śṛṅgāra ādīn manyante nāṭaka ādi prekṣaṇena kāvya śravaṇena vā rasa puṣṭiḥ na kartavyā anyeṣām tu darśanam ikṣu āmalaka ādīnām yaḥ ntar drava rūpa udaka vat sa rasaḥ tasya niṣpīḍitasya pṛthak kṛtasya pratiṣedhaḥ na punar tad antargatasya tat ca etat ayuktam na hi rasa śabdaḥ drava paryāyaḥ prasiddhaḥ yatra ca yasya ucitam upabhoga anta tvam tat eva tasya niṣidhyate tena madhu māṃsyoḥ bhojane pratiṣedhaḥ na darśana sparśanay

original: śuktāni prāptāmlarasāni[445] kevalāt parivāsād dravyāntarasaṃsargād vāmlatām āpannāni | teṣāṃ ca dvijātidharmatvād eva siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | punargrahaṇaṃ gauṇaśuktaparigrahaṇārtham | tena rūkṣaparuṣā vāco niṣiddhā bhavanti | yad uktaṃ gautamena "śuktā vācaḥ"iti (GDh 2.19), tad idaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ cāsyaivārthasyāviṣkaraṇārtham | rasaśuktāny anūdya sarvāṇīti vidhīyate | tato gauṇaparigrahaḥ siddho bhavati |
analyzed: śuktāni prāpta amla rasāni kevalāt parivāsāt dravya antara saṃsargāt vā amla tām āpannāni teṣām ca dvijāti dharma tvāt eva siddhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ punar  grahaṇam gauṇa śukta parigrahaṇa artham tena rūkṣa paruṣāḥ vācaḥ niṣiddhāḥ bhavanti yat  uktam gautamena śukta PNF vācaḥ iti  tat SNNe idam sarva grahaṇam ca  asya eva arthasya āviṣkaraṇa artha rasa śuktāni anūdya sarvāṇi iti  vidhīyate tatas gauṇa parigrahaḥ siddhaḥ bhavati

original: ye tv evaṃ vyācakṣate śuktaśabdena rasapratiṣedhaḥ sarvaśabdenāmānasāni[446] vacāṃsi, ta idaṃ praṣṭavyāḥ | arthapratiṣiddhānāṃ pratiṣedhārthaṃ sarvagrahaṇaṃ kasmān na bhavati | tathā sati ca dadhyādeḥ śuktībhūtasya pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti | yadi tu prāptim āśritya punaḥ pratiṣedha uktārtho vyākhyāyate, tathā sati na kaścid doṣaḥ |
analyzed: ye tu evam vyācakṣate śukta śabdena rasa pratiṣedhaḥ sarva śabdena amānasāni vacāṃsi te idam praṣṭavyāḥ artha pratiṣiddhānām pratiṣedha artham sarva grahaṇam kasmāt na bhavati tathā sati ca dadhi ādeḥ śuktībhūtasya pratiṣedhaḥ prāpnoti yadi tu prāptim āśritya punar pratiṣedhaḥ ukta arthaḥ vyākhyāyate tathā sati na kaścid doṣaḥ

original: prāṇināṃ maśakamakṣikādīnāṃ bālyād dhiṃsane prāpte yatnataḥ parihārārthaṃ punaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ | svādhyāyavidhyaṅgatvārtho vā | na kevalaṃ hiṃsāyāṃ puruṣārthapratiṣedhātikramo[447] yāvat svādhyāyavidhyarthātikramo 'pi | śuktādiṣv apy evaṃ kasmān na kalpyata iti ced asti tatra viṣayāntare sāvakāśatvam, ekarūpasya viṣayasya vyarthatvaṃ sati gatyantare garīyaḥ || 2.177 ||
analyzed: prāṇinām maśaka makṣikā ādīnām bālyāt hiṃsane prāpte yatnataḥ parihāra artham punar pratiṣedhaḥ svādhyāya vidhi aṅga tva arthaḥ vā na kevalam hiṃsāyām puruṣa artha pratiṣedha atikramaḥ yāvat śukta ādiṣu api evam kasmāt na kalpyate iti ced asti tatra viṣaya antare sāvakāśa tvam eka rūpasya viṣayasya vyartha tvam sati gati antare garīyaḥ

original: na punar iyam āśaṅkā kartavyā "naikasvāmikaṃ bhuñjīta, api tu bahusvāmikam avibhaktabhrātṛsaṃbandhi" | ekasyānnam ekaṃ vānnam ekānnam, tad atti bhuṅke ekānnādī | vratī brahmacārī | prakarṇād eva labdhaḥ, ślokapūraṇārtho vratiśabdaḥ |
analyzed: na punar iyam āśaṅkā kartavyā na eka svāmikam bhuñjīta api tu bahu svāmikam avibhakta bhrātṛ saṃbandhi ekasya annam ekam vā annam eka annam tat atti bhuṅke eka anna ādī vratī brahmacārī prakarṇāt eva labdhaḥ śloka pūraṇa arthaḥ vrati śabdaḥ

analyzed: atra artha vādaḥ bhaikṣeṇa eva kevalena vratinaḥ yā vṛttiḥ śarīra dhāraṇam upavāsa tulya phalā sā vṛttiḥ smaryate

original: ayam apavādo nimittaviśeṣe bhaikṣavṛttyupadeśasya | devadaivatye devoddeśena brāhmaṇabhojane kriyamāṇe, pitrye ca pitṝn uddiśyābhyarthito 'dhyeṣitaḥ, kāmam ekānnam aśnīyāt | na tu svayaṃ yāceta | tac ca[468] vratavad vratāviruddhaṃ[469] madhumāṃsavarjitam ity arthaḥ | vratavad ṛṣivad iti ca śabdadvayenaika evārtha ucyate, na punar grāmāraṇyayoḥ karmabhedena vyavasthā | vṛttānurodhāt tu dvirabhidhānam | ṛṣir vaikhānasas tadaśanābhyanujñāne māṃsam api brahmacāriṇo 'nujñātaṃ syāt | tasya hi "vaiṣkam apy upabhuñjīta" (GDh 3.31) iti māṃsāśanam apy asti | devā devatā yasya tad devadaivatyam | tac cāgnihotradarśapūrṇamāsādiṣu daiveṣu karmasu brāhmaṇabhojanam āmnātam, āgrahāyaṇyādiṣu cāmnātam[470] "brāhmaṇān bhojayitvā svastyayanaṃ vācayet" iti | tatreyam anujñā |
analyzed: ayam apavādaḥ nimitta viśeṣe bhaikṣa vṛtti upadeśasya deva daivatye deva uddeśena brāhmaṇa bhojane kriyamāṇe pitrye ca pitṝn uddiśya abhyarthitaḥ dhyeṣitaḥ kāmam eka annam aśnīyāt na tu svayam yāceta tat ca vrata vat vrata aviruddham madhu māṃsa varjitam iti arthaḥ vrata vat ṛṣi vat iti ca śabda dvayena ekaḥ eva arthaḥ ucyate na punar grāma araṇyayoḥ karma bhedena vyavasthā vṛtta anurodhāt tu dvis abhidhānam ṛṣiḥ vaikhānasaḥ tad aśana abhyanu

original: anye tu saptamyādāv ādityādidevoddeśena yat kriyate brāhmaṇabhojanaṃ tad devadaivatyaṃ manyante | tad asat | na hi bhujer devatāsaṃbandho 'sti, ayāgasādhanatvāt tasya | na tūddeśyamātraṃ[471] devatā, "upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadāti," "gṛhaṃ saṃmārṣṭi" ity upādhyāye gṛhe 'pi prasaṅgāt | bhujer hi pratyakṣo bhoktrā saṃbandhaḥ | ādityas tu na kārakam, na coddeśyo gṛhavat, na tadarthaṃ bhojanam | dvitīyā hi bhoktrarthatāṃ jñāpayati, nādityārthatām | na caitat kvacin noditam "ādityādyuddeśena brāhmaṇān bhojayet" iti |
analyzed: anye tu saptamī ādau āditya ādideva uddeśena yat kriyate brāhmaṇa bhojanam tat deva daivatyam manyante tat asat na hi bhujeḥ devatā saṃbandhaḥ u sti a yāga sādhana tvāt tasya na tu uddeśya mātram devatā upādhyāyāya gām dadāti gṛham saṃmārṣṭi iti upādhyāye gṛhe pi prasaṅgāt bhujeḥ hi pratyakṣaḥ bhoktrā saṃbandhaḥ ādityaḥ tu na kārakam na ca uddeśyaḥ gṛha vat na tad artham bhojanam dvitīyā hi bhoktṛ artha tām jñāpayati na āditya artha tām

original: samācārād vidhiḥ kalpyata iti cen, na, tasyopalabhyamānamūlatvāt | asti hi mūlam, bāhyāḥ smṛtayaḥ | tatra tarhi brāhmaṇabhojanena devatāḥ prīṇayed iti śāstrārthaḥ | na cāyam arthaḥ śakyaḥ kalpayitum | na hi devatāprītipradhānaḥ śāstrārthaḥ, kiṃ tarhi vidhyarthapradhānaḥ | na cāsmin vidhyartha ādityādīnāṃ devatābhimatānāṃ viṣayadvārakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ, nāpy adhikāradvārakaḥ | na hi bhedanādivan nimittam, nāpi paśvādivat svasaṃbandhitayā kāmyate, abhogyarūpatvāt | atha tadgatā tuṣṭiḥ kāmyate | sāpy ātmasiddhau pramāṇāntaram apekṣate | na ca tad asti | na hy ādityādituṣṭiḥ pratyakṣādisiddhā paśvādivad yena kāmyena pareṣṭividhinā yujyeta |
analyzed: samācārāt vidhiḥ kalpyate iti ced na tasya upalabhyamāna mūla tvāt asti hi mūlam bāhyāḥ smṛtayaḥ tatra tarhi brāhmaṇa bhojanena devatāḥ prīṇayet iti śāstra arthaḥ na ca ayam arthaḥ śakyaḥ kalpayitum na hi devatā prīti pradhānaḥ śāstra arthaḥ kim tarhi vidhi artha pradhānaḥ na ca asmin vidhi arthe āditya ādīnām devatā abhimatānām viṣaya dvārakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ na api adhikāra dvārakaḥ na hi bhedana ādi vat nimittam na api paśu ādi vat sva sa

original: atha tu matprabhur it svābhipretena phalen yajayiṣyantīti | etad api pramāṇābhāvād upekṣaṇīyam | na cāsminn arthe vidhiḥ pramāṇam | sa hi jñātasyānuṣṭhātṛviśeṣaṇasya svasaṃbandhitayā puruṣaṃ niyuṅkte, na punaḥ kāmyamānasya sadbhāvam avagamayati | pramāṇāntarāvagataṃ hi kāmyam anuṣṭhātṛviśeṣaṇam, anuṣṭhānasādhyam[472] anuṣṭhātṛsaṃbandhīti vidhiḥ pramāṇam iti mimīte |
analyzed: atha tu mad prabhuḥ id sva abhipretena phalen yajayiṣyanti iti etat api pramāṇa abhāvāt upekṣaṇīyam na ca asmin arthe vidhiḥ pramāṇam sa hi jñātasya anuṣṭhātṛ viśeṣaṇasya sva saṃbandhi tayā puruṣam niyuṅkte na punar kāmyamānasya sadbhāvam avagamayati pramāṇa antara avagatam hi kāmyam anuṣṭhātṛ viśeṣaṇam anuṣṭhāna sādhyam anuṣṭhātṛ saṃbandhi iti vidhiḥ pramāṇam iti mimīte

original: athāyaṃ yāgas tasya ca bhojanaṃ pratipattiḥ | bhavatu, yadi śiṣṭasamācāraḥ | bhojanaṃ tāvan na devatāsaṃbandhi sākṣād iti na sādhyam | yāgavyavahitas tu saṃbandho na nivāryate | na cātra yāgabuddhyā pravartate, kiṃ tarhi brāhmaṇeṣu bhojiteṣu devatā tuṣyatīti | ato na devatā bhojanakārakaṃ na kārakaviśeṣaṇam | tato na viṣayatvena[473] saṃbandhaḥ | uddeśyatvam apy ādityādīnāṃ nāsti | bhojane hi sa uddiśyate yasmai bhojanaṃ dīyate | tac ca brāhmaṇebhyaḥ | na coddeśyamātraṃ devatā "upādhyāyāya gāṃ dadāti," "gṛhaṃ saṃmārṣṭi" iti gṛhopādhyāyayor api prasaṅgāt |
analyzed: atha ayam yāgaḥ tasya ca bhojanam pratipattiḥ bhavatu yadi śiṣṭa samācāraḥ bhojanam tāvat na devatā saṃbandhi sākṣāt iti na sādhyam yāga vyavahitaḥ tu saṃbandhaḥ na nivāryate na ca atra yāga buddhyā pravartate kim tarhi brāhmaṇeṣu bhojiteṣu devatā tuṣyati iti atas na devatā bhojana kārakam na kāraka viśeṣaṇam tatas na viṣaya tvena saṃbandhaḥ uddeśya tvam api āditya ādīnām na asti bhojane hi saḥ uddiśyate yasmai bhojanam dīyate tat ca brāhma

original: nanu ca pitrye kathaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanam | tatrāpi hi na pitarau devatāḥ syuḥ | na ca homasya pitryatvam, devatāntaraśravaṇāt | ādityādiprīter iva pitṛprīteḥ pramāṇāntarāsiddhatvān na vidheḥ saṃbandhaḥ sādhyatayā |
analyzed: nanu ca pitrye katham brāhmaṇa bhojanam tatra api hi na pitarau devatāḥ syuḥ na ca homasya pitrya tvam devatā antara śravaṇāt āditya ādi prīteḥ iva pitṛ prīteḥ pramāṇa antara asiddha tvāt na vidheḥ saṃbandhaḥ sādhya tayā

original: yataḥ pitara evātrādhikāriṇaḥ kartāraś ca | apatyotpādanenaiva sarvam etat pitṛbhiḥ kṛtam | evam artham evāsāv utpāditaḥ "dṛṣṭādṛṣṭam upakāraṃ kariṣyati" iti | tataś ca yathā sarvasvāre 'bhāvād auttarakālikeṣv aṅgeṣu "brāhmaṇāḥ saṃsthāpayata me yajñam" iti praiṣyaṃ mṛtasya kartṛtvam | evam atrāpi draṣṭavyam | etāvān viśeṣaḥ | tatrādhikārāntaraprayuktā[477] jīvikārthino bhṛtiparikrītā ṛtvijaḥ kartāraḥ | iha tu tadvidhiprayukta eva putraḥ | yathaivotpattividhiprayuktasya putrārtheṣu pituḥ saṃskāreṣu adhikāro 'nuśāsanaparyantatvāt[478] tasya vidheḥ, evaṃ pitrarthe śrāddhādau putrasya | tathaiva jīvinaḥ pituḥ "vṛddhau tu mātāpitarau" (MDh 111.5 added verse) ity avaśyaṃ kartavyam | evaṃ diṣṭaṃ gataṃ tasyāpi |
analyzed: yatas pitaraḥ eva atra adhikāriṇaḥ kartāraḥ ca apatya utpādanena eva sarvam etat pitṛbhiḥ kṛtam evam artham eva asau utpāditaḥ dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭam upakāram kariṣyati iti tatas ca yathā sarvasvāre bhāvāt auttarakālikeṣu aṅgeṣu brāhmaṇāḥ saṃsthāpayata me yajñam iti praiṣyam mṛtasya kartṛ tvam evam atra api draṣṭavyam etāvān viśeṣaḥ tatra adhikāra antara prayuktāḥ jīvikā arthinaḥ bhṛtiparikrītāḥ ṛtvijaḥ kartāraḥ iha tu tad

original: na[482] kartur vaidikaṃ phalam ity etad anyathā pariṣkriyate[483] | yathaiva vaiśvānaraviśiṣṭaputravattālakṣaṇaṃ pitur eva phalaṃ, nākartṛgāmitā phalasya, evam ihāpi putrasyaiva tatphalaṃ yā pituḥ prītiḥ | ubhayathā pitṛkartṛgāmitā phalasya na virudhyate | apatyotpādanenaivaitādṛśasya phalasyeṣṭatvāt, pitṝṇām api nākāmitaphalāpattiḥ |
analyzed: na kartuḥ vaidikam phalam iti etat anyathā pariṣkriyate yathā eva vaiśvānara viśiṣṭa putravat tā lakṣaṇam pituḥ eva phalam na akartṛ gāmi tā phalasya evam iha api putrasya eva tat phalam yā pituḥ prītiḥ ubhayathā pitṛ kartṛ gāmi tā phalasya na virudhyate apatya utpādanena eva etādṛśasya phalasya iṣṭa tvāt pitṝṇām api nā akāmita phala āpattiḥ

original: yadi na śrāddhe[484] pitaro devatāḥ, kathaṃ tarhi pitryam etat karmeti devatātaddhitaḥ |
analyzed: yadi na śrāddhe pitaraḥ devatāḥ katham tarhi pitryam etat karma iti devatā taddhitaḥ

original: uddeśyatvasāmānyād[485] iti vadāmaḥ | "yuṣmadupakārārtham idaṃ brāhmaṇabhojanam" iti pitara upadiśyante | piṇḍapitṛyajñe tu pitaro devatā eva | na śrāddhe pitṝṇāṃ devatātvaṃ manyante | yat tu brāhmaṇā bhojyante tad yathāgnau homa ājyapuroḍāśādīnāṃ[486] hy avadānasya | tādṛśam etat | tathā ca brāhmaṇāḥ pitṛtvam āpadyante | ato 'nnapariveṣaṇakāle pitara evoddeśyā "yuṣmabhyam idaṃ na mama" iti | brāhmaṇās tv āhavanīyasthānīyāḥ | etāvān viśeṣo yad āhavanīye haviḥ prakṣipyate, brāhmaṇānāṃ tu saṃnidhāpyate, te tu svayam upādadata iti |
analyzed: uddeśya tva sāmānyāt iti vadāmaḥ yuṣmad upakāra artham idam brāhmaṇa bhojanam iti pitaraḥ upadiśyante piṇḍapitṛyajñe tu pitaraḥ devatāḥ eva na śrāddhe pitṝṇām devatā tvam manyante yat tu brāhmaṇāḥ bhojyante tat yathā agnau homaḥ ājya puroḍāśa ādīnām hi avadānasya tādṛśam etat tathā ca brāhmaṇāḥ pitṛ tvam āpadyante atas nna pariveṣaṇa kāle pitaraḥ eva uddeśyāḥ yuṣmabhyam idam na mama iti brāhmaṇāḥ tu āhavanīya sthānīy

original: na ca "śrāddhaṃ yāgo na tatra[487] devatārthaḥ svāhākāraḥ," sviṣṭakṛdādiṣu darśaṇāt | ato yāgo 'pi san śrāddhakarma pitryarthaṃ bhaviṣyati | pitṝṇāṃ devatātvaṃ phalabhāvitvaṃ na virotsyate[488] | tṛtīye kiṃcid anuktam eva tatsaṃbaddhaṃ vakṣyāmaḥ |
analyzed: na ca śrāddham yāgaḥ na tatra devatā arthaḥ svāhākāraḥ sviṣṭakṛt ādiṣu darśaṇāt atas san śrāddha karma pitrī artham bhaviṣyati pitṝṇām devatā tvam phala bhāvi tvam na virotsyate tṛtīye kiṃcid anuktam eva tad saṃbaddham vakṣyāmaḥ

original: tasmān nādityādayo brāhmaṇabhojane devatā iti sthitam |
analyzed: tasmāt na āditya ādayaḥ brāhmaṇa bhojane devatāḥ iti sthitam

original: nanu cāvyāpakam etad api lakṣaṇam: yāge uddeśyaḥ devatā" ity antareṇāpi yāgasaṃbandhe devatāvyavahāradarśanāt | "devatānāṃ ca pūjanam," "daivatāny abhigacchet" iti na pūjā[489] nāpy ābhimukhyena gamanaṃ pādavihārātmakaṃ devatāḥ prati saṃbhavati |
analyzed: nanu ca avyāpakam etat api lakṣaṇam yāge uddeśyaḥ devatā iti antareṇa api yāga saṃbandhe devatā vyavahāra darśanāt devatānām ca pūjanam daivatāni abhigacchet iti na pūjā nā api ābhimukhyena gamanam pāda vihāra ātmakam devatāḥ prati saṃbhavati

original: naiṣa doṣaḥ | yatra devatācodanā tatraitat pūjāvidhānaṃ bhaviṣyati, vaiśvadevadevatāsv agnihotrādisaṃbandhinīṣu vā |

analyzed: bhūta artha anuvādena iyam aparā praśaṃsā kleśam duḥkham mātā ca pitā ca nṝṇām apatyānām saṃbhave garbhāt prabhṛti daśamāt varṣāt mātuḥ kleśaḥ garbha dhāraṇam prasavaḥ prāṇa haraḥ strīṇām jātasya ca saṃvaraṇa yogaḥ kleśaḥ sa sarvasya svayam saṃvedyaḥ pituḥ api upanayanāt prabhṛti veda artha vyākhyānāt saṃbhava śabdena atra garbhādāham ucyate tat hi na kleśa āvaham kim tarhi tad uttara kāla bhāvinyaḥ etāḥ kriyāḥ tāḥ h
